item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_store01.name: Prism "Hazard" Laser Shotgun
item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_store01.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. The Hazard Edition is safety yellow with diagonal black stripes.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_blue01.name: Quartz "Crusader" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_blue01.description: Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon. This special edition features Crusader branding.

item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01_tint01.name: FS-9 "Blacklist" LMG
item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01_tint01.description: Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. The Blacklist edition features a dark black finish.

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_tint03.name: Prism "Firesteel" Laser Shotgun
item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_tint03.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. The Firesteel Edition consists of a grey base color with red highlights.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black01.name: Devastator "Midnight" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_blue01.name: Prism "Crusader" Laser Shotgun
item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_blue01.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. This special edition features Crusader branding.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_gold01.name: Gallant "Executive Edition" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_gold01.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:behr_binoculars_01_tint03.name: XDL "Forest" Monocular Rangefinder
item:behr_binoculars_01_tint03.description:
The highly accurate XDL Monocular Rangefinder from Behring is as suitable on an expedition as it is on the battlefield. Ruggedly constructed with high-quality lenses, easy-to-read display, and a light-amplification mode, the XDL provides 10x magnification to reliably provide exact-distance laser measurements on faraway targets.

The Forest edition features a two-tone light and dark green finish.

item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_white01.name: Arrowhead "Stormfall" Sniper Rifle
item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_white01.description: Klaus & Werner's Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white02.name: Gallant "Boneyard" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white02.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_iae2023.name: Karna "Ascension" Rifle
item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_iae2023.description: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

item:behr_binoculars_01_tint01.name: XDL "Snowfall" Monocular Rangefinder
item:behr_binoculars_01_tint01.description:
The highly accurate XDL Monocular Rangefinder from Behring is as suitable on an expedition as it is on the battlefield. Ruggedly constructed with high-quality lenses, easy-to-read display, and a light-amplification mode, the XDL provides 10x magnification to reliably provide exact-distance laser measurements on faraway targets.

The Snowfall edition features a pristine white finish.

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_tint01.name: Prism "Bonedust" Laser Shotgun
item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_tint01.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. The Bonedust Edition is tan with violet and blue highlights.

item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_mr01.name: Vendetta "Siegebreaker" HMG
item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_mr01.description:
Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.

The Siegebreaker edition features a two-tone gray camo with bold yellow accents.

item:none_smg_energy_01.name: Ripper "Sunblock" SMG
item:none_smg_energy_01.description: Scrapped together from whatever parts and pieces were available, the Ripper SMG can probably do enough damage to get you out of a tight spot. Just be ready for things to get messy. The Sunblock edition feature a yellow finish.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_black01.name: Arclight "Midnight" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_black01.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint01.name: Quartz "Deadfall" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint01.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The "Deadfall" edition is primarily muted green with black highlights.

item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_luminalia.name: C54 "Luminalia" SMG
item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_luminalia.description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The Luminalia edition sports a festive red and green design.

item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_green01.name: Ravager-212 "Outcast" Twin Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_green01.description: The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The rough splashes of neon green against the gunmetal gray give the Outcast edition an aggressively chaotic appearance.

item:none_shotgun_ballistic_01_green01.name: Deadrig 'Noxious' Shotgun
item:none_shotgun_ballistic_01_green01.description: The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil. The Noxious variant features more green coloration due to the scrap metal used during its assembly.

item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01_300.name: S-38 "One Empire" Pistol
item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01_300.description: Thanks to a streamlined design and a lightweight polymer frame that helps to minimize recoil, it's easy to see why the versatile and dependable S-38 from Behring has become a trusted sidearm across the Empire. This special edition features an imperial blue slide to commemorate the ongoing efforts of 'One Empire,' a community-based government initiative.

item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_firerats0.name: Ravager-212 "Scorched" Twin Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_firerats0.description: The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:lbco_pistol_energy_01_sunset01.name: Yubarev "Igniter" Pistol
item:lbco_pistol_energy_01_sunset01.description: Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Former merc turned weapon manufacturing mogul Irina Arkadova oversaw every aspect of the weapon, imbuing it with power, practicality, and panache. Featuring a classic woodgrain grip and cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range. A lustrous orange coating makes the Igniter edition a colorful addition to any loadout.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_yellow01.name: Pulse "Pyrotechnic" Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_yellow01.description: The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating. This special edition features Pyrotechnic Amalgamated branding.

item:grin_multitool_01_default_cutter.name: Pyro RYT Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_default_cutter.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier.

item:volt_rifle_energy_01_black_gold01.name: Parallax "Downburst Camo" Energy Assault Rifle
item:volt_rifle_energy_01_black_gold01.description:
With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires.

The "Downburst Camo" is characterized by a black camo pattern with elegant gold detailing.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_collector02.name: Quartz "Hunter Camo" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_collector02.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

Tan, dark brown, and black combine for the "Hunter Camo" edition of the weapon.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_collector03.name: Quartz "Cobalt Camo" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_collector03.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The "Cobalt Camo" edition features a striking dark blue and black camo pattern.

item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_pink_red0.name: R97 "Kismet" Shotgun
item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_pink_red0.description: The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes - a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. Protect yourself and your loved one with the special Kismet edition of the R97, which features pink and black coloring reminiscent of the ship Yuri Ilyin flew to track down his lost lover Corazon Tan in the classic vid Coramor.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_white01.name: Quartz "microTech" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_white01.description: Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon. This special edition features microTech branding.

item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_firerats01.name: LH86 "Scorched" Pistol
item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_firerats01.description: The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_store02.name: Prism "Disrupt Camo" Laser Shotgun
item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_store02.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. The Disrupt Camo edition utilizes carbon fiber grays and blacks printed in a disruptive pattern to keep your enemies guessing.

item:grin_salvage_repair_01_store01.name: Cambio "Heartthrob" SRT
item:grin_salvage_repair_01_store01.description:
Strip salvage and make repairs with the Cambio, a dual purpose salvage and repair tool (SRT) designed to collect and convert alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. The Cambio SRT features rapid stripping speeds and an impressive battery life, making it an essential gadget for mechanics and spacefarers.

The "Heartthrob" edition is a dreamy, shimmering violet; perfect for making friends and foes weak in the knees.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint01_optic_001.name: Quartz "Deadfall" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint01_optic_001.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The "Deadfall" edition is primarily muted green with black highlights.

item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_store01.name: S71 "Infrared" Rifle
item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_store01.description:
With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy.

Make a statement with the exclusive Infrared edition which pairs an intense ruby with light gray undertones.

item:lbco_sniper_energy_01_sunset01.name: Atzkav "Igniter" Sniper Rifle
item:lbco_sniper_energy_01_sunset01.description: The Atzkav is a unique precision sniper rifle from Lightning Bolt Co. Once the charging handle is engaged, it accurately fires a charged electron to deal significant energy damage that spreads to nearby conductive targets. This special pulse effect also leaves a residual charge in the strike area that increases damage delivered by subsequent electron shots. Alongside the rifle's special firing capabilities, the Atzkav is best known for its distinct barrel that crackles with energy when powering its next shot. A lustrous orange coating makes the Igniter edition a colorful addition to any loadout.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black02.name: Devastator "Nightstalker" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black02.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_white02.name: Arrowhead "Boneyard" Sniper Rifle
item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_white02.description: Klaus & Werner's Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight.

item:lbco_pistol_energy_cen01.name: Yubarev "Deadeye" Pistol
item:lbco_pistol_energy_cen01.description: Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Former merc turned weapon manufacturing mogul Irina Arkadova oversaw every aspect of the weapon, imbuing it with power, practicality, and panache. Featuring a cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range. The exclusive Deadeye edition is black with gold highlights.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white01.name: Gallant "Stormfall" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white01.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_spc.name: Coda Pistol (Modified)
item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_spc.description: Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single .50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03_sf01.name: CQ7 "Skullcap" Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03_sf01.description:
Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. 

The Skullcap edition features an ominous skulls along the length of the rifle atop a black base coat.

item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint03.name: Killshot "Bloody" Rifle
item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint03.description:
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. 

The Bloody version features a red paintjob.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01.name: Pulse Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01.description: The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating.

item:ksar_smg_energy_01_white02.name: Custodian "Boneyard" SMG
item:ksar_smg_energy_01_white02.description: The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_white02_tow.name: P4-AR "Boneyard" Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_white02_tow.description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_white02_tow.name: P8-SC "Boneyard" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_white02_tow.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection.

item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_iae2201.name: Ravager-212 "Red Alert" Twin Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_ballistic_01_iae2201.description: The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_pink_red01.name: Karna "Fate" Rifle
item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_pink_red01.description: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. Show your Coramor passion with this Fate edition of the Karna, which has been made over with bold fuchsia and grey accents.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_lumi01.name: Pulse "Piconalia" Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_lumi01.description:
The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating.

Light up the night this Luminalia with this green Piconalia edition.

item:grin_multitool_01_red_orange01.name: Pyro RYT "ArcCorp" Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_red_orange01.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

item:ksar_sniper_ballistic_01_white_blue.name: Scalpel "Permafrost" Sniper Rifle
item:ksar_sniper_ballistic_01_white_blue.description: The Scalpel is a unique and versatile sniper rifle from Kastak Arms. Designed with a vertical two barrel configuration, it has two fire modes so you can adapt your shot to the situation to deliver a single, powerful shot from a long distance, or fire both barrels in quick succession to create a double-shot burst. This special Permafrost edition features blue and grey coloring reminiscent of a glacier under a blinding winter sky.

item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_mr01.name: S71 "Purgatory Camo" Rifle
item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_mr01.description:
With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy. 

The Purgatory Camo edition boasts a stylish monochrome profile.

item:grin_salvage_repair_iasi.name: Cambio-II "Glacier" SRT
item:grin_salvage_repair_iasi.description:
Strip salvage and make repairs with the Cambio, a dual purpose salvage and repair tool (SRT) designed to collect and convert alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. The Cambio SRT features rapid stripping speeds and an impressive battery life, making it an essential gadget for mechanics and spacefarers. The Cambio-II has been modified to increase the range of the tool, as well as the speed and efficiency of repairs. The recalibration of energy within the device causes it to be slightly less efficient when extracting salvageable materials.

The Glacier edition is an arctic white offset with cold blues.

item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_collector01.name: F55 "Mark I" LMG
item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_collector01.description:
Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with. 

The Mark I edition features a white finish with blue and red highlights.

item:grin_multitool_01_white_blue01.name: Pyro RYT "microTech" Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_white_blue01.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier. This special edition features microTech branding.

item:klwe_smg_energy_01_blue_gold.name: Lumin V "Valor" SMG
item:klwe_smg_energy_01_blue_gold.description: Klaus & Werner's expert craftsmanship is once again on full display to make the Lumin V laser compact energy rifle even more deadly and dependable. A new "interval autofire" mode blasts five-round barrages when the trigger is held down, utilizing the target saturation that comes with autofire while providing breaks to recompensate aim. Even when constantly on the attack, the gun's excellent design provides low recoil and a tight spread. The bold blue and gold color scheme gives the Valor edition a valiant and dignified appeal.

item:none_special_ballistic_01_tint02.name: Boomtube "Mean Green" Rocket Launcher
item:none_special_ballistic_01_tint02.description:
Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

The Mean Green version features a green tint.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_chromic01.name: Arclight "Glimmer" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_chromic01.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job. This exclusive Glimmer edition features a distinct iridescent coating that makes the weapon shimmer with different colors based on lighting conditions and the angle from which it's viewed.

item:klwe_smg_energy_01_mr01.name: Lumin V "SecondWind" SMG
item:klwe_smg_energy_01_mr01.description: Klaus & Werner's expert craftsmanship is once again on full display to make the Lumin V laser compact energy rifle even more deadly and dependable. A new "interval autofire" mode blasts five-round barrages when the trigger is held down, utilizing the target saturation that comes with autofire while providing breaks to recompensate aim. Even when constantly on the attack, the gun's excellent design provides low recoil and a tight spread. To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the weapon with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design along the length of the gun.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_green01.name: Devastator "Warhawk" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_green01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint02.name: Killshot "Goodnight" Rifle
item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint02.description:
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. 

The Goodnight version features a deep navy paintjob.

item:behr_shotgun_ballistic_01_mr01.name: BR-2 "Purgatory Camo" Shotgun
item:behr_shotgun_ballistic_01_mr01.description: Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. The Purgatory Camo edition's grey-on-grey dressing creates a sleek, utilitarian profile.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint02_optic_001.name: Quartz "Black Op" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint02_optic_001.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The green glow of the Quartz's barrel pops against the all black look of the "Black Op" edition.

item:ksar_smg_energy_01_contestedzonerew.name: Custodian SMG
item:ksar_smg_energy_01_contestedzonerew.description: The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_grey_red01.name: C54 "Justified" SMG
item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_grey_red01.description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The "Justified" edition features a cool grey and bright red highlights.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_green01.name: Arclight "Warhawk" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_green01.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job.

item:sasu_pistol_toy_01_orange_purple01.name: WowBlast Desperado Toy Pistol Orange
item:sasu_pistol_toy_01_orange_purple01.description: Make friendly fire fun with the Sakura Sun WowBlast Desperado. Playfully fire foam darts at friends or fictitious foes with these ultra-colorful plastic toy pistols. Whether killing time at a landing zone or during a long-haul through the stars, the WowBlast toy line provides lighthearted excitement and entertainment for the entire family. The Desperado toy pistol is available in several vibrant colors, each featuring a unique sound effect!

item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01.name: A03 Sniper Rifle
item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01.description: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire.

item:hdgw_pistol_ballistic_01.name: Salvo Frag Pistol
item:hdgw_pistol_ballistic_01.description: While the Salvo can be used as a normal pistol, Hedeby didn't stop there. With a longer trigger pull, a freezing primer is injected into the chamber and when released, the heavy firing pin hits with enough force to pulverize the supercooled casing. Accidentally developed as an attempt to mitigate overheating, this charged fire option discharges a deadly spray of high-velocity fragments followed by an ear-shattering boom.

item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_yellow_bla.name: Coda "Big Boss" Pistol
item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_yellow_bla.description: Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single .50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. A sleek black and shocking green color palette give the "Big Boss" edition its signature look.

item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_luminalia_red.name: Arrowhead "Lamplighter" Sniper Rifle
item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_luminalia_red.description: Klaus & Werner's Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight. First released during Luminalia, the Lamplighter edition was inspired by the traditional red holiday color.

item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01.name: FS-9 LMG
item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01.description: Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire.

item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_collector02.name: F55 "Shadowflux" LMG
item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_collector02.description:
Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with.

The Shadowflux variant features a sleek black foundation with subtle chromatic purple tinting.

item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_firerats01.name: C54 "Scorched" SMG
item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_firerats01.description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:klwe_smg_energy_01.name: Lumin V SMG
item:klwe_smg_energy_01.description: Klaus & Werner's expert craftsmanship is once again on full display to make the Lumin V laser compact energy rifle even more deadly and dependable. A new "interval autofire" mode blasts five-round barrages when the trigger is held down, utilizing the target saturation that comes with autofire while providing breaks to recompensate aim. Even when constantly on the attack, the gun's excellent design provides low recoil and a tight spread.

item:behr_shotgun_ballistic_01.name: BR-2 Shotgun
item:behr_shotgun_ballistic_01.description: Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations.

item:none_special_ballistic_01_tint01.name: Boomtube "Ruby" Rocket Launcher
item:none_special_ballistic_01_tint01.description:
Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

This Ruby variant features a red tint.

item:none_smg_energy_01_tint01.name: Ripper SMG
item:none_smg_energy_01_tint01.description: Scrapped together from whatever parts and pieces were available, the Ripper SMG can probably do enough damage to get you out of a tight spot. Just be ready for things to get messy.

item:volt_rifle_energy_01_uee01.name: Parallax "GCD-Army" Rifle
item:volt_rifle_energy_01_uee01.description:
With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires.

This "GCD-Army" edition has yellow wiring and is decorated with a dark and light gray digital camo pattern.

item:klwe_lmg_energy_01_store01.name: Demeco "Streamline" LMG
item:klwe_lmg_energy_01_store01.description:
Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. 

The Streamline edition is a subdued white finished with strokes of deep red and metallic accents.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white02_tow.name: Gallant "Boneyard" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_white02_tow.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint01.name: Killshot "Bleach" Rifle
item:none_rifle_multi_01_tint01.description:
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. 

The Bleach version features a white paintjob.

item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_purple01.name: F55 "Starchaser" LMG
item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_purple01.description: Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with. Created to celebrate the 2954 IAE, the Starchaser edition is a vivid purple with white and black highlights.

item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_iae2201.name: A03 "Red Alert" Sniper Rifle
item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_iae2201.description: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_white01.name: Pulse "microTech" Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_white01.description: The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating. This special edition features microTech branding.

item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd02.name: ParaMed "AA Support" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd02.description:
The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose.

The AA Support edition features a sharp red coloring and was intended for those who assisted Alliance Aid during Levski's time of need. Additionally, this special edition has an increased healing rate to allow injured individuals to return to their vital work even faster.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_store01.name: Gallant "Redline" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_store01.description:
Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

The Redline edition features a fierce red base paint with black and gold highlights.

item:apar_special_ballistic_01_tan01.name: Scourge "Desert Shadow" Railgun
item:apar_special_ballistic_01_tan01.description: Equally devastating to larger threats and hostile vehicles, this shoulder mounted railgun from Apocalypse Arms uses electromagnets to deliver its payload accurately over great distances, making it the Scourge of land, air and space.

item:none_pistol_ballistic_01.name: Tripledown Pistol
item:none_pistol_ballistic_01.description: Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint03_optic_001.name: Quartz "Lumen" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_tint03_optic_001.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The "Lumen" edition mixes crisp white base with black highlights.

item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint01.name: Tripledown "Dark" Pistol
item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint01.description:
Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups.

The Dark version features gray metal and a yellow accent on the grip.

item:volt_lmg_energy_01_tint02.name: Fresnel "Icebox" Energy LMG
item:volt_lmg_energy_01_tint02.description:
The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.

The Icebox edition consists of a chilling white with cold blue features.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_tan01.name: Arclight "Desert Shadow" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_tan01.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_store01.name: Quartz "True Valor" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_store01.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The dynamically designed "True Valor" edition features a blue base with a progression of grey, white, and yellow patterns from muzzle to stock.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_gold01.name: P8-SC "Executive Edition" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_gold01.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection.

item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint02.name: Arlington "Widowmaker" Rifle
item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint02.description:
Gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks looked to classic ballistic designs to construct a long rifle steeped in the past and the future. The Arlington provides accurate marksmanship, an easy cycling of rounds thanks to the lever action design, and multiple fire modes. Artisans shaped the weapon's body by hand to create a piece that's equally fit for the mantle as it is on the frontier.

The Widowmaker edition consists of dark metal body with a deep mahogany stock.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_black01.name: P8-SC "Midnight" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_black01.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection.

item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint03.name: Arlington "Watchpoint" Rifle
item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint03.description:
Gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks looked to classic ballistic designs to construct a long rifle steeped in the past and the future. The Arlington provides accurate marksmanship, an easy cycling of rounds thanks to the lever action design, and multiple fire modes. Artisans shaped the weapon's body by hand to create a piece that's equally fit for the mantle as it is on the frontier.

The Watchpoint edition adds a sleek carbon fiber stock to the rifle that contrasts with the refined silver of the barrel.

item:lbco_pistol_energy_01.name: Yubarev Pistol
item:lbco_pistol_energy_01.description: Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Former merc turned weapon manufacturing mogul Irina Arkadova oversaw every aspect of the weapon, imbuing it with power, practicality, and panache. Featuring a classic woodgrain grip and cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range.

item:crlf_medgun_01_purple01.name: ParaMed "Venule" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_purple01.description: The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose. The "Venule" edition features a rich purple color.

item:none_rifle_multi_01_collector01.name: Killshot "Dominion Camo" Rifle
item:none_rifle_multi_01_collector01.description:
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm.

The Dominion Camo edition adds a dark green camo pattern to the rifle.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_tan01.name: P4-AR "Desert Shadow" Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_tan01.description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

item:grin_multitool_01_ai.name: Pyro RYT Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_ai.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier.

item:volt_lmg_energy_01_tint03.name: Fresnel "Rockfall" Energy LMG
item:volt_lmg_energy_01_tint03.description:
The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.

The Rockfall edition showcases a rugged green with natural accents.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03.name: CQ7 Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03.description: Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_red01.name: Devastator "Brimstone" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_red01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. The "Brimstone" special edition features a bold red top-trim and a dark gray finish on the lower half of the weapon.

item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd03.name: ParaMed "AA Defense" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd03.description:
The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose.

The AA Defense edition features a gray, urban camo pattern and was intended for those who assisted Alliance Aid's Defense Division during Levski's time of need.

item:volt_rifle_energy_01_white01.name: Parallax "microTech" Energy Assault Rifle
item:volt_rifle_energy_01_white01.description: With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires. item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd01.name: ParaMed "AA Transport" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_msn_rwd01.description:

The AA Transport edition features a metallic green coloring and was intended for those who assisted Alliance Aid's Transport Division during Levski's time of need.

item:kegr_fire_extinguisher_01_igniter.name: APX Fire Extinguisher
item:kegr_fire_extinguisher_01_igniter.description: The KE Group's APX Fire Extinguisher has been rated a best-in-class consumer grade safety equipment for well-over a decade making it the industry standard in fire prevention. Filled with a patented gaseous cooling compound, the extinguisher can rapidly smother any fire in sight. The digital screen on the device allows you to monitor the local temperature to help you contain and eliminate fire hazards.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01.name: P4-AR Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01.description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_green01.name: LH86 "Warhawk" Pistol
item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_green01.description: The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine.

item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint02.name: Tripledown "Heavy Metal" Pistol
item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint02.description:
Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups.

The Heavy Metal version features shiny metal and a gray accent on the grip.

item:volt_lmg_energy_01_tint01.description:

item:volt_smg_energy_01_store02.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

Swirls of blue and white give the "Clawed Steel" edition its unique look.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_tan01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. item:grin_multitool_01_default_healing.description:

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01_white01.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. This special edition features microTech branding.

item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_red_green01.name: Karna "Alpine Sunset" Rifle
item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_red_green01.description: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. This special green and red Alpine Sunset edition is sure to make a great Luminalia gift for your loved ones.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_lumi01.name: Quartz "Piconalia" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_lumi01.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

Light up the night this Luminalia with a little help from Pico the Penguin who adorns the side of this blue Piconalia edition.

item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_imp01.description: The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. item:none_lmg_ballistic_01_tint04.name: Pulverizer "Zigzag" LMG
item:none_lmg_ballistic_01_tint04.description:
Nothing like ripping through a huge mag of .50 cal bullets to scare away unwanted guests. Based on a modified FS9, the Pulverizer LMG wastes no time with pleasantries, instead lends itself to a more direct confrontational approach. 

This version features a gray finish with a zigzag pattern.

item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint01.name: Arlington "Gamekeeper" Rifle
item:hdgw_rifle_ballistic_01_tint01.description:
Gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks looked to classic ballistic designs to construct a long rifle steeped in the past and the future. The Gamekeeper edition swaps the stock of the rifle to an elegant walnut wood.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_green01.description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_black02.name: P8-SC "Nightstalker" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_black02.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection.

item:crlf_medgun_01_store01.name: ParaMed "Cyanosis" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_store01.description: The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose. The "Cyanosis" edition features a bold blue color.

item:none_lmg_ballistic_01_tint05.name: Pulverizer "Hemlock Camo" LMG
item:none_lmg_ballistic_01_tint05.description:
Nothing like ripping through a huge mag of .50 cal bullets to scare away unwanted guests. Based on a modified FS9, the Pulverizer LMG wastes no time with pleasantries, instead lends itself to a more direct confrontational approach. 

The Hemlock edition features a green camo pattern.

item:klwe_lmg_energy_01.name: Demeco LMG
item:klwe_lmg_energy_01.description: Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_cen01.name: Devastator "Voyager" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_cen01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_imp01.name: Arrowhead "Pathfinder" Sniper Rifle
item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_imp01.description: Klaus & Werner's Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight.

item:behr_glauncher_ballistic_01_shin01.name: GP-33 MOD "Umber" Grenade Launcher
item:behr_glauncher_ballistic_01_shin01.description: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. The Umber edition is finished in rust and orange.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_iae2201.name: P8-SC "Red Alert" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_iae2201.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

item:volt_smg_energy_01_store03.name: Quartz "New Dawn" Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01_store03.description:
Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

The "New Dawn" edition brings a truly unique look to the weapon with a dazzling kaleidoscope of colors reminiscent of memorable sunrises.

item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint03.name: Tripledown "Ridgeback" Pistol
item:none_pistol_ballistic_01_tint03.description:
Firing three shotgun shells with each pull of the trigger thanks to it's triple-barrel construction, the bolt-action Tripledown pistol is ready to blast its way through anything from the smallest disagreements to massive dustups.

The Ridgeback version features a blue finish and an orange accent on the grip.

item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_red01.name: Karna "Brimstone" Rifle
item:ksar_rifle_energy_01_red01.description: The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. The "Brimstone" special edition features a bold red top-trim and a dark gray finish on the lower half of the weapon.

item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_imp01.name: A03 "Wildwood" Sniper Rifle
item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_imp01.description: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire.

item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01_mr01.name: S-38 "SecondWind" Pistol
item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01_mr01.description: Thanks to a streamlined design and a lightweight polymer frame that helps to minimize recoil, it's easy to see why the versatile and dependable S-38 from Behring has become a trusted sidearm across the Empire for both citizens and law enforcement officers. To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the weapon with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design along the length of the gun.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_contestedzo.name: P4-AR Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_contestedzo.description: Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_green_grey.name: LH86 "Luckbringer" Pistol
item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_green_grey.description: The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. This special green and grey Luckbringer edition released for Stella Fortuna 2954 is a great way to get luck on your side.

item:volt_sniper_energy_01_tint02.name: Zenith "Landslide" Laser Sniper Rifle
item:volt_sniper_energy_01_tint02.description:
The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat.

The Landslide edition features an olive brown that compliments the natural metallic finish of the weapon.

item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_black02.name: LH86 "Nightstalker" Pistol
item:gmni_pistol_ballistic_01_black02.description: The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine.

item:ksar_smg_energy_01_black02_tow.name: Custodian "Nightstalker" SMG
item:ksar_smg_energy_01_black02_tow.description: The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01.name: C54 SMG
item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01.description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick.

item:behr_sniper_ballistic_01_store01.name: P6-LR "Gideon" Sniper Rifle
item:behr_sniper_ballistic_01_store01.description: The Behring P6-LR ballistic sniper rifle more than makes up for its slow rate of fire with a high powered round that's effective from long range. Featuring a scope with variable zoom modes and a barrel composed of a proprietary high-strength alloy, the P6-LR was designed to deliver when needed most. The Gideon edition features a worn teal and yellow finish.

item:grin_multitool_01_white01.name: Pyro RYT "Ghost" Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_white01.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03_tint03.name: CQ7 "Infantry" Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_03_tint03.description: Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Infantry edition features a neutral green and brown finish with black accents.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_tint01.name: Pulse "Blacklist" Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_tint01.description:
The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating.

The Blacklist edition features a black finish.

item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_green_red01.name: F55 "Alpine Sunset" LMG
item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_green_red01.description: Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with. This special green and red Alpine Sunset edition is sure to make a great Luminalia gift for your loved ones.

item:apar_special_ballistic_01_black02.name: Scourge "Nightstalker" Railgun
item:apar_special_ballistic_01_black02.description: Equally devastating to larger threats and hostile vehicles, this shoulder mounted railgun from Apocalypse Arms uses electromagnets to deliver its payload accurately over great distances, making it the Scourge of land, air and space.

item:grin_tractor_01_msn_rwd02.name: MaxLift AA Support Tractor Beam
item:grin_tractor_01_msn_rwd02.description:
Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo.

The AA Support edition features a sharp red coloring and is intended for those who assisted Levski during their time of need.

item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_arctic01.name: A03 "Canuto" Sniper Rifle
item:gmni_sniper_ballistic_01_arctic01.description: Devastate at distance with the A03 sniper rifle. Masterfully designed by Gemini's Tevarin co-founder Clem, the weapon balances a stylish and ergonomic design with a powerful ballistic punch. The A03 delivers an impressive rate of fire for a sniper rifle that sacrifices accuracy for urgency when successive shots are required. Considering its renowned design and unique features, it's easy to see why the A03 has become a favorite of security professionals across the empire.

item:hdgw_pistol_ballistic_01_engraved01.name: Salvo Saeed Frag Pistol
item:hdgw_pistol_ballistic_01_engraved01.description: While the Salvo can be used as a normal pistol, Hedeby didn't stop there. With a longer trigger pull, a freezing primer is injected into the chamber and when released, the heavy firing pin hits with enough force to pulverize the supercooled casing. Accidentally developed as an attempt to mitigate overheating, this charged fire option discharges a deadly spray of high-velocity fragments followed by an ear-shattering boom. This special edition pistol features beautifully detailed scrollwork personally design by Hedeby master gunsmith Keisha Saeed.

item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01.name: Novian Crossbow
item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01.description: The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. With a pull of its firing action, the Novian near-silently launches a heavy bolt that shatters on impact causing devastating damage to close-range targets.

item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_collector01.name: Vendetta "Snow Camo" HMG
item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_collector01.description:
Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.

Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

item:lbco_pistol_energy_01_chromic01.name: Yubarev "Mirage" Pistol
item:lbco_pistol_energy_01_chromic01.description: Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Former merc turned weapon manufacturing mogul Irina Arkady oversaw every aspect of the weapon, imbuing it with power, practicality, and panache. Featuring a classic woodgrain grip and cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range. A special pearlescent coating has been applied to the Mirage edition to make the weapon gleam a range of colors based on how you look at it.

item:none_shotgun_ballistic_01.name: Deadrig Shotgun
item:none_shotgun_ballistic_01.description: The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_tint02.name: Pulse "Rouge" Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_tint02.description:
The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating.

The Rouge edition features a bright red finish.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_sf01.name: Gallant "Conviction Camo" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_sf01.description:
Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

The Conviction Camo edition utilizes a diffuse selection of grays to help blend in with more urban environments.

item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01_xenothreat01.name: FS-9 "Stoneface" LMG
item:behr_lmg_ballistic_01_xenothreat01.description: Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. This entry in the Legendary Bounty Hunters line had famed tracker Farook 'Stoneface' Norris design a look for his beloved FS-9 LMG featuring striking pops of red against a grey base tint.

item:grin_tractor_01_msn_rwd01.name: MaxLift AA Transport Tractor Beam
item:grin_tractor_01_msn_rwd01.description:
Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo.

The AA Transport edition features a metallic green coloring and was intended for those who assisted Alliance Aid's Transport Division during Levski's time of need.

item:volt_rifle_energy_01_red01.description: With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

item:vlk_spewgun_ballistic_reference.description: Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations.

item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_firerats01.name: F55 "Scorched" LMG
item:gmni_lmg_ballistic_01_firerats01.description: Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01.name: R97 Shotgun
item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01.description: The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes - a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire.

item:ksar_smg_energy_01_gold01.name: Custodian "Executive Edition" SMG
item:ksar_smg_energy_01_gold01.description: The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

item:volt_lmg_energy_01_collector02.name: Fresnel "Yormandi" Energy LMG
item:volt_lmg_energy_01_collector02.description:
The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management.

The Yormandi edition is mottled green with a graphic of the fierce reptile along the side.

item:volt_rifle_energy_01.name: Parallax Energy Assault Rifle
item:volt_rifle_energy_01.description: With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires.

item:volt_smg_energy_01.name: Quartz Energy SMG
item:volt_smg_energy_01.description: Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_purple01.name: Devastator "Starchaser" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_purple01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_green01.name: Gallant "Warhawk" Rifle

This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. item:behr_sniper_ballistic_01_black01.name: P6-LR "Archangel" Sniper Rifle
item:behr_sniper_ballistic_01_black01.description: The Behring P6-LR ballistic sniper rifle more than makes up for its slow rate of fire with a high powered round that's effective from long range. Featuring a scope with variable zoom modes and a barrel composed of a proprietary high-strength alloy, the P6-LR was designed to deliver when needed most.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black_purple.name: Devastator "Rager" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_black_purple.description: This semi-automatic electric shotgun from Kastak Arms delivers high-impact plasma blasts ideal for close combat. The Voyager edition upgrades the look with a checked metallic finish offset with blue highlights. An outrageous combination of black, cyan, and purple makes the "Rager" edition an extra good time.

item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_tint03.name: Vendetta "Brightstar" HMG
item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01_tint03.description:

The Brightstar edition features a metallic frame with royal blue highlights ready for any hero to make their stand.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_black01.name: Pulse "Hurston" Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_black01.description: The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. This special edition features Hurston branding.
