item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_iasi.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection. The Echo edition features deep blues and contoured lines that sprawl across the surface of the weapon.

item:grin_multitool_01_default_charge_dr.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

This special pulse effect also leaves a residual charge in the strike area that increases damage delivered by subsequent electron shots. Alongside the rifle's special firing capabilities, the Atzkav is best known for its distinct barrel that crackles with energy when powering its next shot.

item:volt_shotgun_energy_01.description: Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets.

item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01.name: S-38 Pistol
item:behr_pistol_ballistic_01.description: Thanks to a streamlined design and a lightweight polymer frame that helps to minimize recoil, it's easy to see why the versatile and dependable S-38 from Behring has become a trusted sidearm across the Empire for both citizens and law enforcement officers.

item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_purple01.name: C54 "Starchaser" SMG
item:gmni_smg_ballistic_01_purple01.description: Easy to handle and a beauty to behold, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. Created to celebrate the 2954 IAE, the Starchaser edition is a vivid purple with white and black highlights.

item:klwe_lmg_energy_01_purple_blue01.name: Demeco "Ultraviolet" LMG
item:klwe_lmg_energy_01_purple_blue01.description: Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. The Ultraviolet edition features eye-catching violet and orchid coloring.

item:ksar_smg_energy_01_green01.name: Custodian "Warhawk" SMG
item:ksar_smg_energy_01_green01.description: The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_white01.name: Arclight "Stormfall" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_white01.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job.

item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_iae2501.name: P8-SC "Epoque" SMG
item:behr_smg_ballistic_01_iae2501.description: When the top fighting force in the universe chooses a weapon as their standard, it pays to stand up and take notice. The Behring-crafted P8-SC has been the ballistic submachine gun of choice for the UEE Marines since it first came off the production line, but since then, many have come to rely on this weapon for their own personal safety and protection. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring with baroque gold detailing and stylized wings on either side of the grip.

item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_tint02.name: Novian "Ghostmaker" Crossbow
item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_tint02.description:
The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. With a pull of its firing action, the Novian near-silently launches a heavy bolt that shatters on impact causing devastating damage to close-range targets. 

The Ghostmaker edition sports smoke gray accents on a metallic body.

item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_store01.name: R97 "Runic" Shotgun
item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_store01.description:
The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes - a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. 

The Runic variant is enhanced by a distinctive patina and a unique etched design.

item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_sota01.name: Novian "Shroud" Crossbow
item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_sota01.description:
The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. With a pull of its firing action, the Novian near-silently launches a heavy bolt that shatters on impact causing devastating damage to close-range targets.

The Shroud edition features rich, dark wood accents on a dark gray frame making it the ideal equipment for anyone seeking their next adventure.

item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01.name: Vendetta HMG
item:apar_hmg_ballistic_01.description: Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.

item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_firerats01.name: S71 "Bullseye" Rifle
item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_firerats01.description: With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy. Famed Pyro-based bounty hunter Nala "Bullseye" Govea's contribution to the Legendary Bounty Hunters line was to give her favorite weapon a red and black tint fitting for the flare star at the heart of the system she stalks.

item:crlf_medgun_01_grey01.name: ParaMed "Amalgam" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_grey01.description: The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose. The "Amalgam" edition features a sleek grey color.

item:apar_special_ballistic_02_mat01.name: Animus "Quite Useful" Missile Launcher
item:apar_special_ballistic_02_mat01.description: Lift the Animus onto your shoulder and level the opposition on the battlefield. This missile launcher from Apocalypse Arms features a rotating barrel that quickly fires three missiles, making it the perfect weapon to obliterate ground forces or damage vehicles and small ships. When you need to sow destruction to save yourself, you can trust Apocalypse Arms to deliver. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_purple_pin.name: Coda "Ultraviolet" Pistol
item:ksar_pistol_ballistic_01_purple_pin.description: Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single .50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. The Ultraviolet edition features eye-catching violet and orchid coloring.

item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_tint01.name: P4-AR "Blacklist" Rifle
item:behr_rifle_ballistic_01_tint01.description:
Behring's classic P4-AR rifle features a collapsible stock and shortened barrel, making it an ideal choice for close-quarter firefights. Its accuracy and general ease of use make it universally valued among security, military and civilian users.

The Blacklist edition features a black finish.

item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_firerats0.name: R97 "Scorched" Shotgun
item:gmni_shotgun_ballistic_01_firerats0.description: The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes - a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:volt_pistol_energy_01_red_orange01.name: Pulse "Shubin" Laser Pistol
item:volt_pistol_energy_01_red_orange01.description: The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating. This special edition features Shubin branding.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_iae2201.name: Gallant "Red Alert" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_iae2201.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_blue01.name: Devastator "Whirlwind" Shotgun
item:ksar_shotgun_energy_01_blue01.description: Kastak Arms' Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. This special Whirlwind edition features analogous shades of blue reminiscent of waves on a turbulent sea.

item:kegr_fire_extinguisher_01.name: APX Fire Extinguisher
item:kegr_fire_extinguisher_01.description: The KE Group's APX Fire Extinguisher has been rated a best-in-class consumer grade safety equipment for well-over a decade making it the industry standard in fire prevention. Filled with a patented gaseous cooling compound, the extinguisher can rapidly smother any fire in sight. The digital screen on the device allows you to monitor the local temperature to help you contain and eliminate fire hazards.

item:crlf_medgun_01_yellow01.name: ParaMed "Xanthic" Medical Device
item:crlf_medgun_01_yellow01.description: The ParaMed from CureLife is a professional-grade emergency medical device designed to stabilize patients suffering from possible life-threatening injuries. Offering extremely accurate diagnostics and dosing, the ParaMed can treat more patients and offer longer relief with less risk of overdose. The "Xanthic" edition features a bright yellow color.

item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_black01.name: Arrowhead "Midnight" Sniper Rifle
item:klwe_sniper_energy_01_black01.description: Klaus & Werner's Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_tan01.name: Gallant "Desert Shadow" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_tan01.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_black02.name: Gallant "Nightstalker" Rifle
item:klwe_rifle_energy_01_black02.description: Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery.

item:sasu_pistol_toy_01_ea_elim.name: WowBlast Desperado Toy Pistol Red
item:sasu_pistol_toy_01_ea_elim.description: Make friendly fire fun with the Sakura Sun WowBlast Desperado. Playfully fire foam darts at friends or fictitious foes with these ultra-colorful plastic toy pistols. Whether killing time at a landing zone or during a long-haul through the stars, the WowBlast toy line provides lighthearted excitement and entertainment for the entire family. The Desperado toy pistol is available in several vibrant colors, each featuring a unique sound effect!

item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01.name: S71 Rifle
item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01.description: With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy.

item:grin_tractor_01_store01.name: MaxLift Keystone Tractor Beam
item:grin_tractor_01_store01.description:
Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo.

The Keystone edition features a white, gray and blue finish with URW logos.

item:behr_glauncher_ballistic_01_mat01.name: GP-33 MOD "Quite Useful" Grenade Launcher
item:behr_glauncher_ballistic_01_mat01.description: The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_white02.name: Arclight "Boneyard" Pistol
item:klwe_pistol_energy_01_white02.description: A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris' sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job.

item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_tint01.name: Novian "Nighthunter" Crossbow
item:utfl_crossbow_ballistic_01_tint01.description:
The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. With a pull of its firing action, the Novian near-silently launches a heavy bolt that shatters on impact causing devastating damage to close-range targets. 

The Nighthunter edition sports a dipped-in-shadow matte black frame.

item:grin_multitool_01_default_mining.name: Pyro RYT Multi-Tool
item:grin_multitool_01_default_mining.description:
ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY!

The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier.

item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_firerats02.name: S71 "Scorched" Rifle
item:gmni_rifle_ballistic_01_firerats02.description: With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:arma_barrel_flhd_s2.name: Veil Flash Hider2
item:arma_barrel_flhd_s2.description: The Veil Flash Hider2 is an S2 flash hider from ArmaMod. Designed to reduce muzzle flash, it will help keep your position hidden once the action begins.

item:behr_optics_holo_x3_s1_tint01.name: PT3 "Deadfall" (3x Holographic)
item:behr_optics_holo_x3_s1_tint01.description:
Get up close and personal with this 3x magnifying optic from Behring. The PT3 projects a highly visible target marker allowing you to confidently cover your field of view across various lighting and environmental conditions.

The "Deadfall" variant of the scope is muted green.

item:klwe_optics_holo_x1_5_s1.name: HG-15 Jaeger (1.5x Holographic)
item:klwe_optics_holo_x1_5_s1.description: HG-15 Jaeger's features a low power variable magnification providing flexibility when engaging hostiles at close and longer ranges.

item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_acid01.name: Omarof (16x Telescopic)
item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_acid01.description: Get a crystal clear view of distant targets with this powerful telescopic scope from Lightning Bolt Company. Designed specifically for the Atzkav Sniper Rifle, the Omarof uses ultra-precise laser etched lenses that are then multi-coated to allow for high light transmission, wide sight picture and crisp colors, providing strikingly sharp images across significant distances.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s1.name: Emod Stabilizer1
item:arma_barrel_stab_s1.description: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

item:arma_barrel_flhd_s3.name: Veil Flash Hider3
item:arma_barrel_flhd_s3.description: The Veil Flash Hider3 is an S3 flash hider from ArmaMod. Designed to reduce muzzle flash, it will help keep your position hidden once the action begins.

item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_chromic01.name: Omarof (16x Telescopic)
item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_chromic01.description: Get a crystal clear view of distant targets with this powerful telescopic scope from Lightning Bolt Company. Designed specifically for the Atzkav Sniper Rifle, the Omarof uses ultra-precise laser etched lenses that are then multi-coated to allow for high light transmission, wide sight picture and crisp colors, providing strikingly sharp images across significant distances.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_04.name: Stark Compensator1
item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_04.description: Redirecting gases from the barrel to increase the force of bullet impact, this Stark Compensator1 slows the rate of fire but significantly increases damage output.

item:gmni_optics_tsco_x4_s2.name: OT4-RF (4x Telescopic)
item:gmni_optics_tsco_x4_s2.description: Combining a premium 4x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT4-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. When paired with the Gemini S71 or other compatible weapon, the OT4-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements.

item:arma_barrel_flhd_s1.name: Veil Flash Hider1
item:arma_barrel_flhd_s1.description: The Veil Flash Hider1 is an S1 flash hider from ArmaMod. Designed to reduce muzzle flash, it will help keep your position hidden once the action begins.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_03.name: Torrent Compensator3
item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_03.description: The Torrent Compensator3 uses its unique shape to combine the total number of pellets into a tighter spread, increasing accuracy at the cost of lower damage output.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s3.name: Emod Stabilizer3
item:arma_barrel_stab_s3.description: Reduce energy weapon recoil with the Emod Stabilizer3. ArmaMod designed the attachment to improve both horizontal and vertical recoil to ensure a more precise shot.

item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_sunset01.name: Omarof (16x Telescopic)
item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_sunset01.description: Get a crystal clear view of distant targets with this powerful telescopic scope from Lightning Bolt Company. Designed specifically for the Atzkav Sniper Rifle, the Omarof uses ultra-precise laser etched lenses that are then multi-coated to allow for high light transmission, wide sight picture and crisp colors, providing strikingly sharp images across significant distances.

item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3.name: OT8-RF (8x Telescopic)
item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3.description: Combining a premium 8x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT8-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. The standard scope for Gemini's A03 Sniper Rifle, the OT8-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s2.name: Emod Stabilizer2
item:arma_barrel_stab_s2.description: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_02.name: Vera Compensator3
item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_02.description: When modified with the Vera Compensator3, your weapon will have a faster recovery time at cost of some loss of finesse allowing you to provide devastating salvos of suppressive fire.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_03.name: Torrent Compensator1
item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_03.description: The Torrent Compensator1 rewards those with a steady hand and a sharp eye with faster, more controlled fire.

item:behr_binoculars_01_fakeoptic_collec.name: EE16 (16x Telescopic)
item:behr_binoculars_01_fakeoptic_collec.description: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE16. Behring craftsmanship produced a 16x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE16 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

item:behr_binoculars_01_fakeoptic.name: EE16 (16x Telescopic)
item:behr_binoculars_01_fakeoptic.description: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE16. Behring craftsmanship produced a 16x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE16 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

item:volt_optics_holo_x2_s1.name: FocalWave-20 (2x Holographic)
item:volt_optics_holo_x2_s1.description: Providing increased magnification than its previous counterpart, the FocalWave-20 features a down-the-sight visual that tracks the heat and charge of your weapon.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_02.name: Vera Compensator1
item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_02.description: Ideal for operators that specialize in precision aiming, the Vera Compensator1's high density materials increases aim time in favor of reduced recoil.

item:behr_optics_tsco_x16_s3.name: EE16 (16x Telescopic)
item:behr_optics_tsco_x16_s3.description: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE16. Behring craftsmanship produced a 16x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE16 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

item:grin_multitool_01_tractorbeam.name: TruHold Tractor Beam Attachment
item:grin_multitool_01_tractorbeam.description: Whether your feet are on the floor or floating in zero-G, the TruHold attachment for the Pyro RYT Multi-Tool makes lifting and positioning items easier than ever. With its impressive and efficient pull/draw ratio and easy-to-read range finder, the TruHold can be used solo or paired with other beams to tackle heavier targets. Plus, the TruHold has the added benefit of functioning as a personal zero-G traversal device when coupled to an object with a high enough mass.

item:nvtc_optics_rdot_x1_s1_firerats01.name: Delta "Scorched" (1x Reflex)
item:nvtc_optics_rdot_x1_s1_firerats01.description: Ideal for civilians and professionals, the Delta non-magnifying reflex sight from NV-TAC provides a precise illuminated target marker, visible across a wide range of light levels. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1_tint01.name: Gamma Plus "Lumen" (3x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1_tint01.description:
NV-TAC's Gamma Plus is a 3x magnifier sight that utilizes ReadyBrite projection for quick target acquisition. Its durable design makes it perfect for any tactical situation.

The "Lumen" edition is matte white.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s1_firerats01.name: Emod "Scorched" Stabilizer1
item:arma_barrel_stab_s1_firerats01.description: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve spread for a slower but more precise shot. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_contestedzonere.name: Sion "Tweaker" Compensator1
item:arma_barrel_comp_s1_contestedzonere.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator1. ArmaMod's expertly designed S1 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified for a faster fire rate.

item:klwe_ubarrel_lasr_s1_02.name: Tracer Laser Pointer Green
item:klwe_ubarrel_lasr_s1_02.description: Trust Klaus & Werner to manufacture a tactical laser pointer that always hits the mark. The Tracer features a rust and impact resistant casing for an advanced laser diode that produces an efficient and stable beam. This special edition generates a green beam that's easy to see and identify.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_04.name: Stark Compensator3
item:arma_barrel_comp_s3_04.description: Designed by ArmaMod to cycle rounds quicker, the Stark Compensator3 amplifies the speed in which the bullets leave the chamber in exchange for reduced accuracy.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s2_contestedzonere.name: Emod "Tweaker" Stabilizer2
item:arma_barrel_stab_s2_contestedzonere.description: ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve heat distribution and visual stability allowing for a more precise shot. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified to do more damage at the cost of expending more energy.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s3_03.name: Stoic Suppressor3
item:arma_barrel_supp_s3_03.description: As the largest suppressor in the series, the Stoic Suppressor3's heavy duty design reduces noise and recoil, while tightening shot spread.

item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2.name: Tau Plus (4x Telescopic)
item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2.description: The Tau Plus 4x telescopic sight from NV-TAC uses a proprietary optics coating to ensure a crystal clear image regardless of light levels and conditions, allowing you to precisely engage targets at medium range.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_contestedzonere.name: Sion "Tweaker" Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_contestedzonere.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator2. ArmaMod's expertly designed S2 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified for a smoother firing experience.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_firerats01.name: Sion "Scorched" Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_firerats01.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator2. ArmaMod's expertly designed S2 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_collector01.name: FarSight "Snow Camo" (8x Telescopic)
item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_collector01.description:
Designed for long distance precision shooting, the FarSight is carefully crafted to provide unparalleled fidelity of targets. VOLT's TruePicture lens technology provides high levels of light transmission, ensuring easy target acquisition and daylight illumination so you always get your mark.

Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

item:nvtc_optics_rdot_x1_s1.name: Delta (1x Reflex)
item:nvtc_optics_rdot_x1_s1.description: Ideal for civilians and professionals, the Delta non-magnifying reflex sight from NV-TAC provides a precise illuminated target marker, visible across a wide range of light levels.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s3_02.name: Quell Suppressor3
item:arma_barrel_supp_s3_02.description: Designed for stealth work, the Quell Suppressor3 rewards those who take slow, steady shots.

item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x8_s3.name: Theta Pro (8x Telescopic)
item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x8_s3.description: Carefully crafted and calibrated, the Theta Pro delivers precise and effective long distance combat engagement capabilities thanks to its powerful 8x telescopic sight.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1.name: Gamma (1x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1.description: Whether under the blazing sun or on the dark side of a moon, the NV-TAC Gamma projects an easy to see reticle to help ensure your shot finds its mark.

item:klwe_optics_rdot_x1_s1.name: RD-1 Jaeger (1x Red Dot)
item:klwe_optics_rdot_x1_s1.description: The RD-1 Jaeger's simple and functional design provides pinpoint accuracy and rapid target acquisition in close-quarters combat.

item:behr_optics_holo_x3_s1.name: PT3 (3x Holographic)
item:behr_optics_holo_x3_s1.description: Get up close and personal with this 3x magnifying optic from Behring. The PT3 projects a highly visible target marker allowing you to confidently cover your field of view across various lighting and environmental conditions.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s2_02.name: Escalate Stabilizer2
item:arma_barrel_stab_s2_02.description: Unleash the full destructive potential of your weapon with the Escalate Stabilizer2, increasing the fire rate and shot spread at the cost of accuracy.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1_lamp.name: Gamma Plus LL (3x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1_lamp.description: NV-TAC's Gamma Plus is a 3x magnifier sight that utilizes ReadyBrite projection for quick target acquisition. Its durable design makes it perfect for any tactical situation. This version of the scope includes low-light functionality suitable for operations in dim environments.

item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3_store01.name: OT8-RF "HighSec" (8x Telescopic)
item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3_store01.description:
Combining a premium 8x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT8-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. The standard scope for Gemini's A03 Sniper Rifle, the OT8-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements.

The HighSec edition features a carbon fiber finish with red accents.

item:klwe_optics_disp_x8_s3.name: Touchstone (8x Monitor)
item:klwe_optics_disp_x8_s3.description: While conventional scopes can induce eyestrain after extended periods of use, the Touchstone 8x monitor from Klaus & Werner provides ultra-critical eye relief and allows for "heads up" shooting where you are able to simultaneously track targets and observe environmental conditions. Built to cater to a variety of shooters, the Touchstone's reliability and clarity makes it the ideal choice for tactical rifles like the Arrowhead.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1.name: Gamma Plus (3x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x3_s1.description: NV-TAC's Gamma Plus is a 3x magnifier sight that utilizes ReadyBrite projection for quick target acquisition. Its durable design makes it perfect for any tactical situation.

item:behr_optics_holo_x1_s1.name: PT1 (1x Holographic)
item:behr_optics_holo_x1_s1.description: Experience Behring precision with this non-magnifying projection sight. Featuring a highly visible target marker, the PT1 provides ultimate target acquisition to find and lock onto hostiles with ease.

item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint01.name: FarSight "Darkwave" (8x Telescopic)
item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint01.description:
Designed for long distance precision shooting, the FarSight is carefully crafted to provide unparalleled fidelity of targets. VOLT's TruePicture lens technology provides high levels of light transmission, ensuring easy target acquisition and daylight illumination so you always get your mark.

This Darkwave edition draws attention to the sharp contours and edges of the rifle's design.

item:gmni_optics_tsco_x4_s2_firerats01.name: OT4-RF "Scorched" (4x Telescopic)
item:gmni_optics_tsco_x4_s2_firerats01.description: Combining a premium 4x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT4-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. When paired with the Gemini S71 or other compatible weapon, the OT4-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:behr_optics_rdot_x1_s1.name: RF1 (1x Reflex)
item:behr_optics_rdot_x1_s1.description: Perfect for close-quarter combat, the RF1 non-magnifying reflex optic was the first to use Behring's Hyper-Lumen substrate coating to ensure the aiming reticle could be seen in wide range of light conditions, day or night.

item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint03.name: FarSight "Thunderstrike" (8x Telescopic)
item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint03.description:
Designed for long distance precision shooting, the FarSight is carefully crafted to provide unparalleled fidelity of targets. VOLT's TruePicture lens technology provides high levels of light transmission, ensuring easy target acquisition and daylight illumination so you always get your mark.

The deep gray of the Thunderstrike edition emphasizes the weighty feel of the rifle.

item:behr_optics_tsco_x8_s3.name: EE08 (8x Telescopic)
item:behr_optics_tsco_x8_s3.description: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE08. Behring craftsmanship produced a 8x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE08 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

item:grin_multitool_01_mining.name: OreBit Mining Attachment
item:grin_multitool_01_mining.description: The OreBit attachment turns Greycat's Pyro RYT Multi-Tool into a handheld mining machine. It can scan rocks to find worthwhile deposits and then liberate the lode with its powerful mining laser. Next time you're planetside, be sure you bring this attachment or risk leaving easy credits behind.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s1_03.name: Stoic Suppressor1
item:arma_barrel_supp_s1_03.description: Featuring a more spacious chamber that widens shot spread, the Stoic Suppressor1's increased size reduces noise while allowing for superior recoil control.

item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2_firerats01.name: Tau Plus "Scorched" (4x Telescopic)
item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2_firerats01.description: The Tau Plus 4x telescopic sight from NV-TAC uses a proprietary optics coating to ensure a crystal clear image regardless of light levels and conditions, allowing you to precisely engage targets at medium range. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:ksar_optics_tsco_x8_s3.name: Black Prism (8x Telescopic)
item:ksar_optics_tsco_x8_s3.description: Delivering accurate fire at long distances is a skill that comes with practice - and the use of a proper scope like Kastak Arms' Black Prism. Crafted with rugged, multi-coated crystalens to deliver bright, clear visuals, this 8x telescopic sight is completely at home on your favorite rifle.

item:klwe_optics_holo_x3_s1.name: HG-3 Jaeger (3x Holographic)
item:klwe_optics_holo_x3_s1.description: Featuring KLWE's proprietary NocturnaLite hardware, the HG-3 Jaeger provides enhanced vision in low-light situations.

item:behr_optics_tsco_x4_s2.name: EE04 (4x Telescopic)
item:behr_optics_tsco_x4_s2.description: Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE04. Behring craftsmanship produced a 4x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. item:arma_barrel_supp_s1_02.name: Quell Suppressor1
item:arma_barrel_supp_s1_02.description: The Quell Suppressor1 utilizes an advanced carbon polymer that reduces both noise and recoil at the cost of increased heat build-up.

item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint02.name: FarSight "Landslide" (8x Telescopic)
item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3_tint02.description:

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_02.name: Vera Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_02.description: The heavy-duty materials utilized in the Vera Compensator2 reduce recoil and increase aim time for precise, controlled bursts.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s2.name: Tacit Suppressor2
item:arma_barrel_supp_s2.description: Strike silently with the Tacit Supressor2. ArmaMod uses a proprietary ceramic coating inside the suppressor to ensure the sound of gunfire remains minimal.

item:volt_optics_holo_x1_s1.name: FocalWave-10 (1x Holographic)
item:volt_optics_holo_x1_s1.description: Manufactured to provide crucial combat information in real-time, the FocalWave-10 features a precise targeting reticle, as well as an enhanced visual display that tracks the heat and charge of your weapon.

item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2_lamp.name: Tau Plus LL (4x Telescopic)
item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x4_s2_lamp.description: The Tau Plus 4x telescopic sight from NV-TAC uses a proprietary optics coating to ensure a crystal clear image regardless of light levels and conditions, allowing you to precisely engage targets at medium range. item:arma_barrel_supp_s3.name: Tacit Suppressor3

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_03.name: Torrent Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_03.description: Designed to overwhelm opponents in the heat of battle, the Torrent Compensator2 increases projectile speed whilst reducing accuracy.

item:hdgw_optics_tsco_x4_s2.name: Myers (4x Telescopic)
item:hdgw_optics_tsco_x4_s2.description: Exquisitely crafted by the gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks, the Myers scope was designed to pair with the graceful lines of their stately Arlington rifle.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1.name: FieldLite Flashlight
item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1.description: The FieldLite is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s1.name: Tacit Suppressor1
item:arma_barrel_supp_s1.description: Strike silently with the Tacit Supressor1. ArmaMod uses a proprietary ceramic coating inside the suppressor to ensure the sound of gunfire remains minimal.

item:klwe_ubarrel_lasr_s1.name: Tracer Laser Pointer Orange
item:klwe_ubarrel_lasr_s1.description: Trust Klaus & Werner to manufacture a tactical laser pointer that always hits the mark. The Tracer features a rust and impact resistant casing for an advanced laser diode that produces an efficient and stable beam. This special edition generates an orange beam that's easy to see and identify.

item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3.name: FarSight (8x Telescopic)
item:volt_optics_tsco_x8_s3.description: Designed for long distance precision shooting, the FarSight is carefully crafted to provide unparalleled fidelity of targets. VOLT's TruePicture lens technology provides high levels of light transmission, ensuring easy target acquisition and daylight illumination so you always get your mark.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1_lamp.name: Gamma LL (1x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1_lamp.description: Whether under the blazing sun or on the dark side of a moon, the NV-TAC Gamma projects an easy to see reticle to help ensure your shot finds its mark. This version of the scope includes low-light functionality suitable for operations in dim environments.

item:klwe_optics_tsco_3_5x_s2.name: TS-35 Basara (3.5x Telescopic)
item:klwe_optics_tsco_3_5x_s2.description: The TS-35 Basara continues to expand on the high quality of the Basara series, by adding enhanced magnification to the sights, without compromising on quality.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_04.name: Stark Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2_04.description: The Stark Compensator2 disperses energy more evenly from the gun barrel to counteract recoil, helping you stay sure and steady with every shot.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s2.name: Sion Compensator2
item:arma_barrel_comp_s2.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator2. ArmaMod's expertly designed S2 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_lasr_s1.name: 250-E Laser Pointer
item:nvtc_ubarrel_lasr_s1.description: The 250-E is an intuitive aiming aid that produces a laser visible to you and others. NV-TAC built the attachment to be lightweight yet durable so it won't add extra weight to your weapon.

item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_imp01.name: Omarof (16x Telescopic)
item:lbco_optics_tsco_x16_s3_imp01.description: Get a crystal clear view of distant targets with this powerful telescopic scope from Lightning Bolt Company. Designed specifically for the Atzkav Sniper Rifle, the Omarof uses ultra-precise laser etched lenses that are then multi-coated to allow for high light transmission, wide sight picture and crisp colors, providing strikingly sharp images across significant distances.

item:volt_ubarrel_flsh_s1.name: Lux Flashlight
item:volt_ubarrel_flsh_s1.description: Constructed using a reinforced metallic casing and fracture-less glass, VOLT's Lux Flashlight gives you light when you need it most. Once equipped, it is able to communicate with the weapon's own sensors to activate automatically when the weapon is in use.

item:klwe_ubarrel_flsh_s1.name: Brightspot Flashlight Purple
item:klwe_ubarrel_flsh_s1.description: The Brightspot flashlight embodies Klaus & Werner's engineering ethos. A simple and sturdy design built to withstand intense combat and environmental conditions means the Brightspot always works when you need it most. This special edition projects a purple circle that makes the beam less conspicuous from a distance.

item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3_firerats01.name: OT8-RF "Scorched" (8x Telescopic)
item:gmni_optics_tsco_x8_s3_firerats01.description: Combining a premium 8x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT8-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. The standard scope for Gemini's A03 Sniper Rifle, the OT8-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x8_s3_lamp.name: Theta Pro LL (8x Telescopic)
item:nvtc_optics_tsco_x8_s3_lamp.description: Carefully crafted and calibrated, the Theta Pro delivers precise and effective long distance combat engagement capabilities thanks to its powerful 8x telescopic sight. This version of the scope includes low-light functionality suitable for operations in dim environments.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s3.name: Sion Compensator3
item:arma_barrel_comp_s3.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator3. ArmaMod's expertly designed S3 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target.

item:arma_barrel_comp_s1.name: Sion Compensator1
item:arma_barrel_comp_s1.description: Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator1. ArmaMod's expertly designed S1 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target.

item:volt_optics_holo_x3_s1.name: FocalWave-30 (3x Holographic)
item:volt_optics_holo_x3_s1.description: The FocalWave-30 provides enhanced vision to engage targets at close and medium distances. In addition, your weapon's heat and charge is displayed in the lens optics offering enhanced combat awareness.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_firerats01.name: FieldLite "Scorched" Flashlight
item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_firerats01.description: The FieldLite is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

item:behr_optics_holo_x2_s1.name: PT2 (2x Holographic)
item:behr_optics_holo_x2_s1.description: Improve your combat accuracy with this 2x magnifying sight from Behring. Built with meticulous care and craftsmanship, the PT2 has become an essential optic for everyone from sport shooters to law enforcement professionals.

item:arma_barrel_stab_s3_02.name: Escalate Stabilizer3
item:arma_barrel_stab_s3_02.description: By allowing for increased energy consumption, the Escalate Stabilizer3 can overclock your weapon to significantly reduce charge time and increase damage output.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_02.name: FieldLite Flashlight Blue
item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_02.description: The FieldLite Blue is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Blue edition projects a focused blue light in the shape of a square. The molded lens keeps falloff to a minimum, making it perfect for illuminating targets at distance.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_03.name: FieldLite Flashlight Yellow
item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_03.description: The FieldLite Yellow is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Yellow edition projects a scattered yellow starlike pattern making it preferable for target acquisition at medium distance.

item:weaponmount_nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1.name: Gamma (1x Holographic)
item:weaponmount_nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1.description: Whether under the blazing sun or on the dark side of a moon, the NV-TAC Gamma projects an easy to see reticle to help ensure your shot finds its mark.

item:grin_multitool_01_healing.name: LifeGuard Medical Attachment
item:grin_multitool_01_healing.description: Crafted as a joint effort between Greycat Industrial and leading medical device manufacturer CureLife, the LifeGuard attachment is a compact and light-weight emergency medical treatment option powered by the Pyro RYT Multi-Tool. It is perfect for handling jobsite emergencies and temporarily alleviating symptoms until professional medical care can be sought.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s2_02.name: Quell Suppressor2
item:arma_barrel_supp_s2_02.description: With careful placement of high insulation materials to allow increased heat dissipation, the Quell Suppressor2 ensures you'll stay cool under pressure in favor of a slightly wider bullet spread.

item:arma_barrel_supp_s2_03.name: Stoic Suppressor2
item:arma_barrel_supp_s2_03.description: Using a more heavyweight barrel attachment for increased control, the longer chamber of the Stoic Suppressor2 grants reduced noise and increased accuracy at the cost of slower responsiveness.

item:klwe_optics_tsco_2_5x_s2.name: TS-25 Basara (2.5x Telescopic)
item:klwe_optics_tsco_2_5x_s2.description: Utilizing the precise and immaculately crafted lenses that Klaus & Werner are known for, the TS-25 Basara provides unparalleled clarity and accuracy when equipped.

item:grin_multitool_01_cutter.name: OxyTorch Cutter Attachment
item:grin_multitool_01_cutter.description: Transform Greycat's Pyro RYT Multi-Tool into a precision cutter with the OxyTorch attachment. Built to quickly and easily slice through appropriate materials, the OxyTorch harnesses the power of the multi-tool to deliver accurate cuts with clean edges, making it a convenient attachment ideal for both professionals and hobbyists.

item:klwe_optics_holo_x2_s1.name: HG-2 Jaeger (2x Holographic)
item:klwe_optics_holo_x2_s1.description: Specializing in medium distance combat, the HG-2 Jaeger excels in situations where you want to keep your distance from hostiles.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x2_s1_lamp.name: Gamma Duo LL (2x Holographic)
item:nvtc_optics_holo_x2_s1_lamp.description: NV-TAC extensively tested the Gamma Duo across a range of extreme temperatures to assure that thermal drift doesn't affect the accuracy of this 2x magnifier sight. This version of the scope includes low-light functionality suitable for operations in dim environments.

item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_04.name: FieldLite Flashlight Red
item:nvtc_ubarrel_flsh_s1_04.description: The FieldLite Red is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Red edition projects a red light in the shape of a circle. Ideal for situations when illumination on close range targets is essential without projecting a bright light that could be easily spotted.

item:nvtc_optics_holo_x1_s1_tint01.name: Gamma "Black Op" (1x Holographic)

Whether under the blazing sun or on the dark side of a moon, the NV-TAC Gamma projects an easy to see reticle to help ensure your shot finds its mark.

item:grin_multitool_01_salvage_repair.name: Cambio-Lite SRT Attachment
item:grin_multitool_01_salvage_repair.description: Greycat delivers once again, bringing their popular salvage and repair tool (SRT) as an attachment for the Multi-Tool. Though not as powerful as the Cambio, the Cambio-Lite also collects and converts alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. Whether stripping salvage for creds or patching a hull to make a ship space-safe, the Cambio-Lite is ready to get to work.

item:nvtc_optics_rdot_x1_s1_lamp.name: Delta LL (1x Reflex)

item:banu_melee_01_blue01.name: Pambada Knife
item:banu_melee_01_blue01.description: Honed to a razor-fine edge, the Pambada knife has a wide range of applications. The serrated edge is great for cutting through soft and flexible materials like ropes or fabrics while the gut hook can be used to overcome materials with a tougher resistance. The sharpened angular point of the blade ensures the Pambada can still pierce, rounding out the weapon's versatile toolset. It is made with the same rust-resistant, ultra-sharp metal alloy found in other Banu knives and features an intricately detailed handle of distinctively Banu origin.

item:apar_melee_01.name: Demon Fang Combat Knife
item:apar_melee_01.description: The Demon Fang is a simple yet sinister split blade knife supported by a sturdy and lightly textured handle. Vibrant red cutting edges highlight the knife's unusual and intimidating look, guaranteeing to give anyone second thoughts about getting in its way.

item:utfl_melee_01_red01.name: FSK-8 "Bloodline" Combat Knife
item:utfl_melee_01_red01.description: The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. While many become enamored with dazzling tech of modern weaponry, UltiFlex has focused on making a simple effective combat tool. Featuring a balanced 1055 carbon steel blade honed to a razor's edge, this knife is capable of handling all the abuse you can throw at it.

item:ksar_melee_01_brown01.name: Sawtooth "Sirocco" Combat Knife
item:ksar_melee_01_brown01.description: Don't end up on the wrong side of the Sawtooth combat knife. The blade embodies Kastak Arms' aggressive styling and was designed to stab, slice, or saw. It features a strong tip for piercing, a straight edge for slicing, and a unique serrated edge with microblades for when you really need to rip through something. The blade is also made with a special ceramic polymer coating that enhances its strength and overall wear resistance. For the special Sirocco edition, a light brown color was added to the coating to make it even more visually distinct.

item:utfl_melee_01.name: FSK-8 Combat Knife
item:utfl_melee_01.description: The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. item:ksar_melee_01_orange01.name: Sawtooth "Sunspike" Combat Knife
item:ksar_melee_01_orange01.description: Don't end up on the wrong side of the Sawtooth combat knife. The blade embodies Kastak Arms' aggressive styling and was designed to stab, slice, or saw. It features a strong drop tip for piercing, a straight edge for slicing, and a unique serrated edge with microblades for when you really need to rip through something. The blade is also made with a special ceramic polymer coating that enhances its strength and overall wear resistance. For the special Sunspike edition, an orange handle and aged finish was added to make the blade more visually distinct.

item:rrs_melee_01_fallout01.name: TBF-4 "Balefire" Combat Knife
item:rrs_melee_01_fallout01.description: Built for combat but ready for everyday use, the TBF-4 "Balefire" combat knife will get the job done. Built with an ultrastrong 1055 carbon steel blade, this tactical knife ends with a tanto point perfect for stabbing and penetrating hard surfaces while the serrated spine can be used to slice and shred. Beautifully balanced, the TBF-4 also features a grip with two finger grooves to ensure your hand stays in place during use. The special "Balefire" edition features a threatening red blade.

item:banu_melee_01_red01.name: Myuda Knife
item:banu_melee_01_red01.description: A brutally effective product of Banu engineering, the Myuda knife is a vicious weapon designed for leaving wounds that won't heal easily. The proprietary metal alloy used in the construction of the blade is rust-resistant and remains ultra-sharp even after extensive use. The intricately detailed handle gives it a distinctly Banu style and provides texture to ensure a tight grip.

item:vncl_melee_01_store01.name: VCK-1 "Payback" Blade
item:vncl_melee_01_store01.description:

Taking inspiration from those brutal knives, the VCK-1 from UltiFlex features a split blade, ceremonial detailing, and has been finished with a unique patina that closely resembles the Vanduul's own bespoke alloys.

The Payback edition features red 'X' markings.

item:banu_melee_02.description: The Myondo is a distinct, curved blade with a notched finger-well and bejeweled pommel. The texture on both the blade and handle come from the unique forging process used by the Banu craftsmen who make them.

item:behr_ltp_kinetic_nocarry.name: ADO-5 Laser Mine
item:behr_ltp_kinetic_nocarry.description:
he ADO-5, or commonly called ADOSS is a Laser Mine from Behring. It is a deadly tool you want to own to protect your precious goods, but you never want to accidentally step into. Where ADO stand for Area Denial Ordnance you can be sure that your property is well protected.

This deadly gadget is made of an light weight aluminum case that holds a strong explosive. It can be easily attached to any surface with our state of the art attachment technology.

The laser beam comes in predefined lengths for all your use cases, to provide a good variance for various room types, hallways or even giant hangars. 

Handle with care! Once activated the only way to turn it off is by destruction.

item:food_box_noodle_01_a_animation.description: A soy sauce based home-style chicken noodles. Perfect for warming up those cold berths.

item:food_skewered_rat_pile_roasted.name: Aloprat Skewer
item:food_skewered_rat_pile_roasted.description: Aloprat is a hearty species of rodent found across Human occupied space, and even can survive aboard space stations and ships eating a variety of food and scraps. This aloprat has been skewered and roasted rotisserie style for crisp skin and gamey, fatty meat.

item:drink_can_pips_01_a.name: Pips A20
item:drink_can_pips_01_a.description: Heavily scientifically researched to provide optimal energy restoration and targeted thirst quenching, Pips is trusted the 'verse over. Pips A20 is specially formulated for long-haul pilots to provide sustained results.

item:drink_screwtop_tumbler_1_b.name: "Quantainium" Water Bottle
item:drink_screwtop_tumbler_1_b.description: Make others believe you have the ability to tap into the awesome power of quantainium with this novelty water bottle. Unscrewing the lid produces a eerie blue glow that will make others truly wonder what you've got inside.

item:food_burger_wham_01_veggie_a.name: Veggie Wham
item:food_burger_wham_01_veggie_a.description: Made by Whammer's skilled chefs, our signature Veggie Wham checks all your crave boxes. All Whams come with crisp greens, tomatoes, piccamix, and Crave Sauce.

item:food_burrito_torp_02_a.name: Locked-on Lentil Burrito
item:food_burrito_torp_02_a.description: Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their hearty and healthy Locked-On Lentil burrito, featuring a blend of lentils and vegetables wrapped in their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla.

item:none_consumable_accesschip_ghost_le.name: Walesko
item:none_consumable_accesschip_ghost_le.description: Instructions for how to build this simple cryptokey were first published publicly in 2887 by political activist Aris Walesko who had hoped that it would lead to greater governmental transparency. Though not up to the standards of most modern security protocols, this slow and unreliable device it is still in use today owing to its ease of construction and wide availability from numerous small manufacturers.

item:drink_mug_big_bennys_1_a.name: Big Benny's Mug
item:drink_mug_big_bennys_1_a.description:
Grab Drink! 

This playful Big Benny's mug features the brand's iconic mascot. Its unique dual layer design features a chip and fade proof ceramic that feels comfortable in the hand with special plastic coating on the lip and handle to ensure it's never too hot to touch.

item:drink_bottle_synergy_01_sport_a.name: SynergySport
item:drink_bottle_synergy_01_sport_a.description: SynergySport is formulated to deliver balanced active rehydration to replenish and restore so that you can get back to your body's peak performance sooner.

item:drink_bottle_llb_01_gen_a.name: Gen Liberty Ale (Bottle)
item:drink_bottle_llb_01_gen_a.description: Liberty Lake beer has been brewed by families on Terra for generations to provide a crisp, clean ale perfect to partake when you arrive at those little moments made to be spent enjoying life. Gen Liberty is a tart lactic ale perfect for warm nights.

item:eld_jacket_05_01_11.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Parker
item:eld_jacket_05_01_11.description: This grey and blue collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in orange.

item:cba_nurse_scrubs_01_01_04.name: Mahoney Nurse Scrub Top Honeycomb
item:cba_nurse_scrubs_01_01_04.description: The Mahoney Nurse Scrub shirt is made for medical professionals looking an accommodating and comfortable fit. item:hdh_jacket_11_01_13.name: Sharud Wrap and Arm Bands Redwood
item:hdh_jacket_11_01_13.description: The Sharud is an ideal top for staying cool in hot weather. Advanced production techniques allow Habidash to make a light yet absorbent shawl that looks and feels like handspun natural cotton but at a fraction of the cost. The three arm band pieces provide stylish accents and come embedded with microchips that tracks body temperature and other vitals.

item:dmc_jacket_04_600i01_01.name: 600i Flight Jacket
item:dmc_jacket_04_600i01_01.description: Embrace elegance with the 600i flight jacket. Featuring beautiful brown synthetic leather and an ultra-soft yet durable inner lining, the jacket honors the stunning ship with the best bedtime view in the verse. Origin's logo graces the jacket's front and a patch featuring a top down view of the ship's classic contours adorns the back.

item:987_jacket_03_01_04.name: Tempo Jacket Golden Brown
item:987_jacket_03_01_04.description: Fashionable, fun and flashy, the Tempo is a quilt studded jacket featuring a unique metallic finish to make you stand out from the crowd. 987 balanced this bold design with sections of synthetic leather and complementary colors ringing the waistband and inner collar.

item:dmc_jacket_04_fleetweek2024_01.name: Invictus Flight Jacket Steel
item:dmc_jacket_04_fleetweek2024_01.description: Celebrate Launch Week in iconic style with this commemorative flight jacket featuring a Navy patch on the front and a large Invictus patch on the back. This synthetic leather jacket comes with two front pockets and ribbed waistband and cuffs that guarantee a good fit.

item:dmc_jacket_12_01_01.name: Camion Jacket
item:dmc_jacket_12_01_01.description: Come prepared with the Camion. This button up blue jacket delivers on style with complimentary dark brown synthetic leather around the neck, shoulders, and arms. A cross-shoulder sling bag and integrated utility belt allows you to carry plenty of gear and keep it organized.

item:ops_jacket_07_01_12.name: Waldron Jacket Black
item:ops_jacket_07_01_12.description: The Waldron suit exudes sophistication by fusing classic style with contemporary flourishes. OpalSky redefines success with this geometric patterned jacket, featuring a pinstriped false-shirt and tie layered underneath, plus a unique split-seam back.

item:scu_service_apron_02_ellroys01_01.name: Dash Apron Ellroy's
item:scu_service_apron_02_ellroys01_01.description: Stegman's Dash apron is made from a thick, stain-resistant polyfiber that not only protects the wearer but looks as good at the end of the shift as it does at the beginning. The practical design is embellished with a bold waistline and pocket detailing alongside a fun accent color panel on the lower skirt.

item:eld_jacket_03_01_02.name: Parvat Jacket Backdraft
item:eld_jacket_03_01_02.description: Weather the cold with this waterproof and insulated jacket from Escar Limited. Featuring a stylish design and unique dual-layer collar, the Parvat will keep you warm when you need it most.

item:eld_jacket_03_01_16.name: Parvat Jacket Frozen Spring

item:tmbl_vest_racing_01_01_9tails01.description: This version of the Renegade Racing vest has been modified from its original form. The Renegade Racing vest provides protection against road rash without adding to your lap time. Graphene-based nanocomposite plating makes the vest extremely light yet ultra-durable. Ideal for everything from idyllic rides to heart pounding last laps.

item:grin_toxic_jumpsuit_01_01_02.name: Tru Barrier Hazard Suit Cinnabar
item:grin_toxic_jumpsuit_01_01_02.description: Guard yourself from toxic environmental hazards with the TruBarrier Hazard Suit, constructed from industrial-grade fabric and coated with a multi-layered, laminated polymer that offers a broad range of chemical protection without sacrificing mobility. item:dmc_frontier_jacket_01_03_01.name: Silverton Jacket AA Collections
item:dmc_frontier_jacket_01_03_01.description:
When you're on the frontier, you need reliable clothing that won't fray when the going gets tough. That's why DMC made the Silverton jacket with double-stitched, element-resistant leather and plenty of roomy pockets so you can keep your supplies on hand. With the Silverton, you'll be prepared for anything.

item:ccc_bear_helmet_01_01_05.name: Fieldsbury Dark Bear Helmet Lime
item:ccc_bear_helmet_01_01_05.description: Celebrate Day of the Vara in sinister style with this officially licensed Fieldsbury Dark Bear helmet. This twisted version of the Fieldsbury Bear mascot launched a seasonal soda flavor before being co-opted into a series of high-profile pranks. Ever since, the bear's big, toothy grin and off-set flickering eyes have become a standard sight at Day of the Vara celebrations. Now CC's Conversions has designed and delivered an official, high quality reproduction of this iconic mascot, available in six striking colors.

item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_03_.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Starcrossed
item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_03_.description: Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Starcrossed edition is modeled after the armor worn by Yuri Ilyin in the famous 25th century vid, Coramor, which inspired the eponymous lovers' festival.

item:srvl_parasite_helmet_02_01_01.name: Parasite V: Dark Birth Replica Helmet
item:srvl_parasite_helmet_02_01_01.description: Seven years after the original vid shocked the empire, Parasite V: Dark Birth took terror to a new level. Now with the Azrael helmet from CC's Conversions you can look the part with the grim visage of a skull peering out from beneath the visor of this otherwise normal looking helmet.

The Sapphire version casts the skull in a pixelated blue light.

item:vgl_flightsuit_helmet_02_01_01.description:

item:qrt_mantis_undersuit_helmet_02_01_0.description:

This special variant is adorned with a Year of the Rat symbol on the back and features deep red and gleaming gold accents with an all-gold visor to help give your lunar new year an auspicious start.

item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_01_.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Twilight
item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_01_.description: Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up.

item:mrai_flightsuit_helmet_01_01_01.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Mirai
item:mrai_flightsuit_helmet_01_01_01.description: The Neutrino Racing Helmet uses advanced Xi'an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight helmet durable enough to endure the stresses of high-velocity racing. Taking inspiration from traditional Saisei culture and aesthetics, the stark red highlight and special edition Mirai branding results in a striking but elegant design.

item:srvl_parasite_helmet_01_01_01.name: Parasite Replica Helmet
item:srvl_parasite_helmet_01_01_01.description: The original Parasite vid established a new face of fear and terrified the Empire. This iconic look can now be yours with the Parasite Replica helmet from CC's Conversions. Digital scans of the original prop helped to reproduce every gruesome detail. Despite its distinct design, the Parasite Replica helmet is space-rated and fully functional. It can be safely worn both in and out of atmosphere, or wherever you're looking to scare someone.

item:mrai_flightsuit_helmet_01_07_12.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet BlackFire

item:ccc_scarecrow_helmet_01_01_01.name: The Hill Horror Helmet
item:ccc_scarecrow_helmet_01_01_01.description: Haunt your friends with a helmet inspired by the terrifying appearance adopted by famed serial killer Neville Lott. The classic slasher vid 'The Hill Horror' helped make this look a staple at Day of the Vara festivals, and this high-quality reproduction replicates the iconic movie look down to every last devious stitch. The Hill Horror helmet is made with an actual gunny sack sealed with a special finish that can withstand a wide variety of environmental conditions, and covering a comfortable space-rate helmet. Become a walking nightmare and celebrate Day of the Vara in sinister style with this helmet.

item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_01_.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Lovestruck
item:rsi_odyssey_undersuit_helmet_01_01_.description: Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. item:mrai_flightsuit_helmet_01_05_01.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Star Kitten
item:mrai_flightsuit_helmet_01_05_01.description: Sakura Sun's take on the iconic racing helmet worn by Team Takahashi racers can now be yours. item:ccc_viral_helmet_01_02_01.name: Lost Plague Helmet Biohazard Blue

CC's Conversions utilized a proprietary lightweight yet sturdy rubber to accurately reproduce the deadly plague's signature spines so you can enjoy hours of wear without straining your neck.

Keep your eyes on the prize and your head protected with the Testudo helmet. It features a wide faceplate and a durable outer shell that protrudes above the forehead in a way specifically designed to absorb and efficiently disperse the energy of impacts.

item:fta_medium_helmet_01_01_05.name: Strata Helmet
item:fta_medium_helmet_01_01_05.description: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design features high quality materials and a next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres.

Visor is AR Crosshair compatible. The Red Menace edition features bold markings across the faceplate.

item:clda_env_heavy_helmet_01_iae2023_01.name: Novikov "Ascension" Helmet
item:clda_env_heavy_helmet_01_iae2023_01.description: In order to confidently explore cold environments, Caldera built the Novikov exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a bespoke helmet that integrates with the cutting edge life support system, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

item:cds_combat_heavy_helmet_03_05_01.name: DCP Armor Helmet Clawed Steel
item:cds_combat_heavy_helmet_03_05_01.description: Endure the most brutal attacks with the DCP heavy armor. This set features easy-swing joints that provide freedom of movement in the heat of battle, and was crafted with a multi-layer shock-absorbing shell that helps its wearer shake off the hardest hits.

item:slaver_armor_heavy_helmet_01_01_03.name: Defiance Helmet Sunchaser
item:slaver_armor_heavy_helmet_01_01_03.description: The Defiance features a fully enclosed battle helmet constructed with two layers of composite weaves underneath armor plating, providing you maximum protection against penetrating and concussive attacks. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

item:srvl_combat_heavy_helmet_03_02_01.name: Wrecker Helmet Payback
item:srvl_combat_heavy_helmet_03_02_01.description:
Favored by the most brutal of hunters, the Wrecker armor is a fusion of discarded metal and pilfered fabric cobbled together to offer protection while stalking prey. It features an intimidating and enclosed helmet with four eye-like red sensors to keep the wearer connected to the world around them.

The Payback version is sprayed with red paint and anointed with bone fragments and Vanduul armor pieces.

item:kap_combat_heavy_helmet_02_01_01.name: Monde Helmet
item:kap_combat_heavy_helmet_02_01_01.description: From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde helmet. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system.

item:vgl_specialist_heavy_helmet_01_01_1.name: Sangar Helmet Grey/Black
item:vgl_specialist_heavy_helmet_01_01_1.description: The Sangar helmet from Vigil is both practical and eye-catching, thanks to a prominent brow ridge meant to absorb and disperse strikes through the helmet's special impact-resistant inner lining. Featuring high quality diamond laminate lens over the eyes and a top tier dual sensor air filtration system protruding from the front like fangs, Virgil has ensured that the Sangar helmet can take a beating and look good doing it in every situation from a hostile environment to a frantic firefight.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_helmet_01_03_1.name: Morozov-SH Helmet Terrene
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_helmet_01_03_1.description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers.

To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the armor with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design.

item:cds_combat_heavy_helmet_03_03_01.name: DCP Armor Helmet Jungle Camo
item:cds_combat_heavy_helmet_03_03_01.description: Endure the most brutal attacks with the DCP heavy armor. This set features easy-swing joints that provide freedom of movement in the heat of battle, and was crafted with a multi-layer shock-absorbing shell that helps its wearer shake off the hardest hits.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_helmet_03_crus.name: Morozov-SH-S Helmet Crusader Edition
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_helmet_03_crus.description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for the company's security services. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

item:cds_armor_heavy_helmet_02_03_xenoth.name: ADP-mk4 Helmet Righteous

item:kap_combat_heavy_helmet_01_02_01.name: Monolith Helmet Runic
item:kap_combat_heavy_helmet_01_02_01.description:
Boasting triple laminate full-head shielding and military-grade carbon silk environmental seals, Kilgore and Poole's Monolith helmet combines unparalleled protection with a razor-sharp field of vision. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

The Runic variant is enhanced by a distinctive patina and a unique etched design.

item:clda_utility_heavy_helmet_05_03_01.name: Stirling Exploration Helmet Olympian Edition
item:clda_utility_heavy_helmet_05_03_01.description: Designed to withstand inhospitable environments, the Stirling Exploration Suit provides a base level of protection from environmental hazards including radiation. Combining Caldera's advanced insulation fabrics with sophisticated polymers, the Stirling is able to safeguard the wearer whilst minimizing disruption to movement. Additionally, a self-cleaning system automatically activates after radiation exposure to expunge dangerous excess down to nominal levels. This helmet is only compatible with the Stirling Exploration Suit. The Olympian Edition melds gleaming yellows and golds with a subtle hexagonal pattern, completed with a reflective visor to create an almost luminous appearance.

item:omc_utility_heavy_helmet_01_02_01.name: Corbel Helmet Crush
item:omc_utility_heavy_helmet_01_02_01.description:
Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.

item:outlaw_legacy_armor_heavy_helmet_01.name: Fortifier Helmet Base
item:outlaw_legacy_armor_heavy_helmet_01.description: Protect your most valuable asset with the Fortifier. Intended for extremely hostile environments, this heavy helmet makes up for its limited visibility with extra plating that protects the neck and back of the head.

item:clda_utility_heavy_helmet_05_02_01.name: Stirling Exploration Helmet Transistor Edition
item:clda_utility_heavy_helmet_05_02_01.description: Designed to withstand inhospitable environments, the Stirling Exploration Suit provides a base level of protection from environmental hazards including radiation. item:fio_glasses_01_01_01.name: Sarrab Glasses
item:fio_glasses_01_01_01.description: The Sarrab are stylish half-rim glasses that are so light you'll forget you're wearing them. Ideal for everyday use, these glasses feature clear polycarbonate temple arms that complement the lens without demanding too much attention.

item:oct_glasses_01_01_01.name: Apex Glasses
item:oct_glasses_01_01_01.description: Tough but stylish, these all-purpose performance glasses utilize scratch-resitant lens technology to keep your vision clear during training or competition.

item:scu_goggles_02_01_01.name: SightRight Goggles
item:scu_goggles_02_01_01.description: Stegman's SightRight goggles strike a careful balance between ultralight comfort and professional-quality protection. The enhanced polycarbonate frame offers maximum eye safety with a durable scratch-resistant lens construction that also features an award-winning anti-fog coating to maintain visibility in the harshest of worksites.

item:rmb_goggles_01_01_01.name: Avalos Scout Goggles
item:rmb_goggles_01_01_01.description: Tech meets tough with the Avalos Scout goggles. Their unique and sturdy frame ensures that the lenses remain intact even after unexpected impacts or sudden atmospheric changes. Built for harsh environments but bold enough to be worn anywhere.

item:spv_glasses_01_01_01.name: AvantX Glasses
item:spv_glasses_01_01_01.description: A distinct one piece lens with a unique geometric design makes the AvantX glasses stand out from the crowd. SPV expertly blends cutting edge style and technology for a distinct look and feel that's fashion forward.

item:scu_goggles_02_01_04.name: SightRight Goggles Yellow

item:r6p_glasses_01_01_01.description: When the future's looking bright, reach for these aviator shades from R6 Pro. With a design that has remained an acknowledged classic for centuries, you can salute the trailblazing aviators of the past as you seek tomorrow's new horizons.
