item:srvl_undersuit_01_01_01.name: Second Life Undersuit
item:srvl_undersuit_01_01_01.description: Featuring the same relatively reliable construction as the Why Not helmet, the Second Life takes some of those tattered old undersuits and gives them new life.

item:clda_env_heavy_unified_01_iae2023_0.name: Novikov "Ascension" Exploration Suit
item:clda_env_heavy_unified_01_iae2023_0.description: In order to confidently explore cold environments, Caldera built the Novikov exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_9ta.name: ORC-mkV Core (Modified)
item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_9ta.description: This version of CDS' ORC-mkV core has been modified from its original form. Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style. The ORC-mkV from Clark Defense Systems has been a battlefield staple for centuries. This highly regarded medium armor blends composite plating with a special fiber reinforced polymer to provide solid protection and a wide range of movement.

item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.name: ORC-mkV Core Imperial
item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.description: Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style. The ORC-mkV from Clark Defense Systems has been a battlefield staple for centuries. This highly regarded medium armor blends composite plating with a special fiber reinforced polymer to provide solid protection and a wide range of movement.

item:slaver_combat_medium_core_01_02_01.name: DustUp Core Ultimatum
item:slaver_combat_medium_core_01_02_01.description:
The DustUp has your back if you're looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing's been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

item:qrt_combat_medium_core_01_01_15.name: Testudo Core Earthshake
item:qrt_combat_medium_core_01_01_15.description: The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort.

item:qrt_combat_medium_core_01_01_01.name: Testudo Core
item:qrt_combat_medium_core_01_01_01.description: The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort.

item:grin_utility_medium_core_01_01_01.name: Aril Core
item:grin_utility_medium_core_01_01_01.description: Originally designed for miners, the Aril armor includes a fully enclosed helmet and high collar providing additional support and protection for the neck and back of the head. An integrated tool belt and attachable backpack can accommodate a variety of tools and supplies to keep your hands free. The Aril armor is available in a variety of vibrant colors to fit your personal taste and for easy identification on the jobsite.

item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.name: ORC-mkV Core Twilight
item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.description: Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style. The ORC-mkV from Clark Defense Systems has been a battlefield staple for centuries. item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.name: ORC-mkV Core Cry-Astro Edition
item:cds_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_01_.description: Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style. The ORC-mkV from Clark Defense Systems has been a battlefield staple for centuries. The Cry-Astro Edition was made specifically for the company.

item:grin_utility_medium_core_02_04_07.name: Strata Core Crusader Edition
item:grin_utility_medium_core_02_04_07.description: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design has been copied by other manufacturers, but the original still reigns supreme with its high quality materials and next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for the company.

item:outlaw_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_.name: Inquisitor Core Olive
item:outlaw_legacy_armor_medium_core_01_.description: Strength and speed combine with the new Inquisitor armor set. item:ccc_medium_armor_core_01_01_iae2024.name: Aves Starchaser Core

item:srvl_combat_medium_core_01_03_01.name: Carrion Core Ashen

The Ashen version is sprayed with white paint and anointed with bone fragments.

item:ccc_medium_armor_core_01_02_01.name: Aves Core Epoque

This medium armor from CC's Conversions provides solid protection while keeping you light on your feet. When paired with the Aves helmet, the suit combines for a striking and unforgettable look.

The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

This EVA-rated suit features new EdgeCore composite weave technology, maximizing protection against projectiles, explosives and the elements while minimizing operator agility.

item:slaver_armor_medium_core_01_01_15.name: DustUp Core Desert
item:slaver_armor_medium_core_01_01_15.description: The DustUp has your back if you're looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire, but the real gem is the modified helmet. That thing was built to withstand explosions, so it should totally protect you against some shots. The whole thing's been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

item:srvl_combat_medium_core_02_01_01.name: Carrion Core Stalker
item:srvl_combat_medium_core_02_01_01.description:
Forged from scavenged metals and ragged clothes, the Carrion armor is a crude concoction of repurposed materials that demonstrates you'll do anything it takes to survive. 

The Stalker variant has been tagged with orange paint, and features a long cape and integrated pieces of Vanduul armor plating.

item:grin_utility_medium_core_02_07_12.name: Strata Core Hurston Black
item:grin_utility_medium_core_02_07_12.description: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design has been copied by other manufacturers, but the original still reigns supreme with its high quality materials and next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres. The Hurston Black variant was made specifically for the company.

item:outlaw_legacy_medium_armor_core_01_.name: Inquisitor Core Ignitor
item:outlaw_legacy_medium_armor_core_01_.description: Strength and speed combine with the new Inquisitor armor set. Strong yet lightweight alloy plating works alongside reinforced polyfiber weaving to save your skin, but not slow you down. When combined with Kastak Arms' intimidating aesthetic, it's easy to see why this medium armor has become infamous across the Empire.

item:nodraw_ccc_medium_armor_core_01_01_.name: Aves Core
item:nodraw_ccc_medium_armor_core_01_01_.description: Honor and embody the Tevarin aesthetic with the Aves armor. Cutting edge manufacturing techniques were used to place white, red, grey, and black plating perfectly to fit the Human form and evoke the shape language imbued into the Tevarin's iconic ships. This medium armor from CC's Conversions is both sensational and practical, providing solid protection while keeping you light on your feet. When paired with the Aves helmet, the suit combines for a striking and unforgettable look.

Strong yet lightweight alloy plating works alongside reinforced polyfiber weaving to save your skin, but not slow you down. When combined with Kastak Arms' intimidating aesthetic, it's easy to see why this medium armor has become infamous across the Empire.

item:nodraw_ccc_medium_armor_legs_01_01_.name: Aves Legs
item:nodraw_ccc_medium_armor_legs_01_01_.description: Honor and embody the Tevarin aesthetic with the Aves armor. Cutting edge manufacturing techniques were used to place white, red, grey, and black plating perfectly to fit the Human form and evoke the shape language imbued into the Tevarin's iconic ships. This medium armor from CC's Conversions is both sensational and practical, providing solid protection while keeping you light on your feet. When paired with the Aves helmet, the suit combines for a striking and unforgettable look.

item:outlaw_legacy_armor_medium_legs_01_.name: Inquisitor Legs (Modified)

item:grin_utility_medium_legs_02_07_12.name: Strata Legs Hurston Black
item:grin_utility_medium_legs_02_07_12.description: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design has been copied by other manufacturers, but the original still reigns supreme with its high quality materials and next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres. The Hurston Black variant was made specifically for the company.

item:cds_combat_medium_legs_03_02_xenoth.name: ORC-mkX Legs Righteous
item:cds_combat_medium_legs_03_02_xenoth.description: This version of CDS' ORC-mkX combat armor has been modified from its original form. The mark X is part of CDS' award-winning Omni-Role Combat armor series. This EVA-rated suit features new EdgeCore composite weave technology, maximizing protection against projectiles, explosives and the elements while minimizing operator agility.

item:grin_utility_medium_legs_01_citcon2.name: Aril Legs Red Alert
item:grin_utility_medium_legs_01_citcon2.description: Originally designed for miners, the Aril armor includes a fully enclosed helmet and high collar providing additional support and protection for the neck and back of the head. The Aril armor is available in a variety of vibrant colors to fit your personal taste and for easy identification on the jobsite.

item:qrt_combat_medium_legs_05_01_01.description:
The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

item:slaver_armor_medium_legs_01_01_15.name: DustUp Legs Desert
item:slaver_armor_medium_legs_01_01_15.description: The DustUp has your back if you're looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire, but the real gem is the modified helmet. That thing was built to withstand explosions, so it should totally protect you against some shots. The whole thing's been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

This highly regarded medium armor blends composite plating with a special fiber reinforced polymer to provide solid protection and a wide range of movement.

item:slaver_combat_medium_legs_01_02_01.name: DustUp Legs Ultimatum
item:slaver_combat_medium_legs_01_02_01.description:
The DustUp has your back if you're looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing's been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

item:qrt_combat_medium_legs_01_01_10.name: Testudo Legs Nightveil
item:qrt_combat_medium_legs_01_01_10.description: The Testudo armor for Quirinus Tech blends battlefield durability with everyday comfort. It weaves tough, yet lightweight, plating with ultra-strong synthetic fibers to provide premium protection. Lining the inside is a proprietary micromodal fabric that's soft to the touch and wicks away moisture for supreme comfort.

item:grin_utility_medium_legs_01_01_04.name: Aril Legs Hazard
item:grin_utility_medium_legs_01_01_04.description: Originally designed for miners, the Aril armor includes a fully enclosed helmet and high collar providing additional support and protection for the neck and back of the head. An integrated tool belt and attachable backpack can accommodate a variety of tools and supplies to keep your hands free. The Aril armor is available in a variety of vibrant colors to fit your personal taste and for easy identification on the jobsite.

item:doom_armor_medium_legs_02_01_01.name: Stitcher Legs
item:doom_armor_medium_legs_02_01_01.description: Dress to impress in scrapheap chic! The Stitcher armor might look like it's held together with tape and good intentions but we swear it's space safe. The intentional ramshackle design features a funky double collar, plenty of storage, and a ribbed industrial hose attached to a metal cylinder on the back just for the hell of it.

item:grin_utility_medium_legs_03_02_01.description: Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. item:vgl_utility_light_core_02_01_01.name: Chiron Core Heartthrob
item:vgl_utility_light_core_02_01_01.description:
Be the first on the scene with the Chiron armor. Designed to provide the essential protection that combat medics need, the armor features ultra-lightweight panelling to keep the wearer quick on their feet without compromising on safety. Crucial, high-impact sections have been reinforced with raised carbon plating on top of a highly durable polyfiber for maximum flexibility.

The Heartthrob edition is a dreamy, shimmering violet adorned with bright digital hearts; perfect for making friends and foes weak in the knees.

item:cds_combat_light_legs_04_01_xenothr.name: FBL-8a Legs (Modified)
item:cds_combat_light_legs_04_01_xenothr.description: Based on CDS' FBL-8a combat armor, this set has been modified from its original form. This light armor will keep you fast on your feet with its strategic mix of protective plating and reinforced nano-weave fabrics. While the armor works with any undersuit, it was specifically designed to match the FBL-8u undersuit with special attention given to how the two fit together to make the set as streamlined and responsive as possible.

item:vgl_utility_light_legs_03_02_01.name: Chiron Legs Foundation
item:vgl_utility_light_legs_03_02_01.description:
Be the first on the scene with the Chiron armor. Designed to provide the essential protection that combat medics need, the armor features ultra-lightweight panelling to keep the wearer quick on their feet without compromising on safety. Crucial, high-impact sections have been reinforced with raised carbon plating on top of a highly durable polyfiber for maximum flexibility.

Celebrate the UEE's commitment to building a brighter future with this Foundation Festival special edition. Designed with Guides and other community leaders in mind, it features a teal polyfiber underlayer and matching accents on the carbon plating sections.

item:kap_combat_light_legs_01_01_02.name: Geist Armor Legs Rogue
item:kap_combat_light_legs_01_01_02.description: An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps.

item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_04_02_01.name: Stirling Exploration Suit Transistor Edition
item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_04_02_01.description: Designed to withstand inhospitable environments, the Stirling Exploration Suit provides a base level of protection from environmental hazards including radiation. Combining Caldera's advanced insulation fabrics with sophisticated polymers, the Stirling is able to safeguard the wearer whilst minimizing disruption to movement. Additionally, a self-cleaning system automatically activates after radiation exposure to expunge dangerous excess down to nominal levels. The Transistor Edition is primarily copper with a white accent that cuts down the middle, finished with a tinted yellow visor.

item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_02_9tails_0.name: Pembroke Exploration Suit RSI Edition (Modified)
item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_02_9tails_0.description: This version of Caldera's Pembroke exploration suit has been modified from its original form. Designed to extend the limits of Human endurance, the Pembroke was built to withstand the extreme heat of inhospitable high temperature environments. Based off of Caldera's best-in-class exploration armor platform, an advanced sensor suite intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. The special RSI Edition of the Pembroke ensures those seeking to cross bold new horizons do so in style.

item:clda_env_armor_heavy_suit_01_01_01.name: Novikov Exploration Suit
item:clda_env_armor_heavy_suit_01_01_01.description: Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov. Caldera built the exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system and spacious backpack, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey.

item:clda_env_armor_heavy_suit_01_01_exp.name: Novikov "Expo" Exploration Suit
item:clda_env_armor_heavy_suit_01_01_exp.description: Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov "Expo". Caldera built the exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system and spacious carryall, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. The "Expo" edition celebrates CitizenCon 2949 by blending orange and purple for an eye catching look that's highly visible against the elements.

item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_03_01_18.name: Stirling Exploration Suit Tungsten Edition
item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_03_01_18.description: Designed to withstand inhospitable environments, the Stirling Exploration Suit provides a base level of protection from environmental hazards including radiation. item:syfb_flightsuit_suit_01_01_01.name: Xanthule Flight Suit
item:syfb_flightsuit_suit_01_01_01.description: Perfected through centuries of innovation, Syang Fabrication's sleek and stylish Xanthule flight suit has been meticulously adapted to the Human physique. The Xanthule suit features breathable lightweight plating made with a carbon-silk weave that provides reliable protection while maintaining the famed House's signature aesthetic.

item:syfb_flightsuit_01_iae2023_01.name: Xanthule Ascension Flight Suit
item:syfb_flightsuit_01_iae2023_01.description: Perfected through centuries of innovation, Syang Fabrication's sleek and stylish Xanthule flight suit has been meticulously adapted to the Human physique. The Xanthule suit features breathable lightweight plating made with a carbon-silk weave that provides reliable protection while maintaining the famed House's signature aesthetic. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

item:rsi_utility_heavy_suit_01_01_12.name: Zeus Exploration Suit Starscape
item:rsi_utility_heavy_suit_01_01_12.description: The Zeus Exploration Suit has been designed to honor some of the earliest space pioneers, the RSI crews who developed and tested the Zeus, the first commercial spacecraft. While the suit is styled to match those used centuries ago with attachments for a helmet and backpack, it contains all of the modern technology and conveniences expected by present-day explorers. item:clda_utility_heavy_suit_01_01_01.name: Pembroke Exploration Suit

item:cds_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_01_0.name: ADP Core Green
item:cds_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_01_0.description: Revolutionary when first released, the ADP heavy armor system was heralded as the pinnacle of personal protection. CDS refined and reshaped the ADP line over the years, but many still consider the original ADP to be the touchstone of military-grade heavy armor.

It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.

item:srvl_combat_heavy_core_03_02_01.name: Wrecker Core Payback
item:srvl_combat_heavy_core_03_02_01.description:
Favored by the most brutal of hunters, the Wrecker armor is a fusion of discarded metal and pilfered fabric cobbled together to offer protection while stalking prey.

The Payback version is sprayed with red paint and anointed with bone fragments and Vanduul armor pieces.

item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_01_15.name: Monolith Armor Core Sandhawk
item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_01_15.description:

The Sandhawk variant features desert brown plating with slate gray accents.

The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_01_01_12.name: Morozov-SH Core Aftershock
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_01_01_12.description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. item:omc_utility_heavy_core_01_01_04.name: Corbel Core Halcyon
item:omc_utility_heavy_core_01_01_04.description:

It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Halcyon edition displays a sharp contrast of bold yellow and muted black.

item:kap_combat_heavy_core_02_09_01.name: Monde Core Purgatory Camo
item:kap_combat_heavy_core_02_09_01.description:
From the masterwork designers of Kilgore & Poole comes the Monde heavy armor. Effortlessly integrating triple-laminate plating with the latest in defensive technology, this armor provides battle-ready protection with a next-class comfort system and specialized flex-point joints.

The Purgatory Camo edition features a sleek gray-on-gray pattern.

item:qrt_specialist_heavy_core_01_03_01.name: Antium Core Midnight Sun
item:qrt_specialist_heavy_core_01_03_01.description: If you're in need of top-of-the-line protection enhanced with bleeding-edge technology, look no further than the Antium Armor Set. Developed by the award-winning engineering team at Quirinus Tech, the suit is fully enclosed to protect its wearer against hazardous environments and the dangers of the battlefield. Instead of a traditional laminate faceplate, the helmet utilizes a suite of sensors to create an uncompromised field of vision.

item:thp_jacket_01_01_01.name: Ixonia Armor Desert Camo
item:thp_jacket_01_01_01.description: Tehachapi knows that you can never have too much storage. This lightweight protective gear comes with a sturdy tool belt, reinforced pouches, and hidden pockets so you can be sure your cargo will stay in place even when you're at your most active. An optional hood and adorned cape provide protection from the wind when worn with the matching helmet.

item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_02_01.name: Monolith Armor Core Runic
item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_02_01.description:

item:outlaw_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_0.name: Citadel Core Dark Red
item:outlaw_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_0.description: Kastak Arms' aggressive design reached its peak with the Citadel. Layers of reinforced armor plating provide maximum security while its striking angular silhouette cuts an imposing figure.

item:omc_utility_heavy_core_01_01_01.name: Corbel Core Smolder
item:omc_utility_heavy_core_01_01_01.description:
Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Smolder edition is primarily gray and black with sharp red segments.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_03_01_01.name: Morozov-SH Core Redshift
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_03_01_01.description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart.

item:cds_armor_heavy_core_01_01_concierg.name: ADP-mk4 Core Exec
item:cds_armor_heavy_core_01_01_concierg.description: When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers. This executive edition features a brushed chrome finish with an inlaid hexagonal pattern.

item:qrt_utility_heavy_core_03_01_01.description:
Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower.

The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_04_01_01.name: Morozov-SH-I Core Pyrotechnic
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_core_04_01_01.description: Featuring the same fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, as the Morozov SH, the SH-I industrial variant was designed by RRS to protect workers employed in hostile zones while ensuring they had the full range of motion required to perform their duties. The Pyrotechnic Amalgamated Edition was made specifically for the company's mining efforts in Pyro during the 26th century.

item:cds_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_01_1.name: ADP Core Twilight
item:cds_legacy_armor_heavy_core_01_01_1.description: Revolutionary when first released, the ADP heavy armor system was heralded as the pinnacle of personal protection. Clark Defense Systems' maximalist design provides plenty of attachment points and excellent protection against the elements and enemy fire. CDS refined and reshaped the ADP line over the years, but many still consider the original ADP to be the touchstone of military-grade heavy armor.

item:srvl_armor_heavy_core_02_01_01.name: Dust Devil Armor Core
item:srvl_armor_heavy_core_02_01_01.description: Salvaged pieces of disused protective gear were welded together to make this intimidating armor set. The cape, made from an old Banu wall-hanging, adds an elegant finishing touch.

item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_06_01.name: Monolith Armor Core Oubliette
item:kap_combat_heavy_core_01_06_01.description:

Boasting triple-laminate ceramic ablative plating and military-grade carbon silk weave joint protection, the Monolith pattern proves you don't have to sacrifice flexibility for the sake of durability.

Designed to intimidate, the Oubliette edition features no-nonsense gray-on-gray accents.

item:srvl_armor_heavy_core_01_01_20.name: Overlord Core Dust Storm

The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

Boasting triple-laminate ceramic ablative plating and military-grade carbon silk weave joint protection, the Monolith pattern proves you don't have to sacrifice flexibility for the sake of durability.

Designed to intimidate, the Oubliette edition features no-nonsense gray-on-gray accents.

item:srvl_armor_heavy_legs_02_01_01.name: Dust Devil Armor Legs
item:srvl_armor_heavy_legs_02_01_01.description: Salvaged ship parts and pieces of disused protective gear were welded together to make this intimidating armor set. Paired with a decorated leather belt.

item:qrt_utility_heavy_legs_02_01_01.name: Palatino Legs Mark I
item:qrt_utility_heavy_legs_02_01_01.description: Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower. The Mark I variant is primarily icy white with blue and red highlights.

item:srvl_armor_heavy_legs_01_01_19.name: Overlord Legs Polarity
item:srvl_armor_heavy_legs_01_01_19.description:
The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

The Polarity edition pairs a deep purple with rusted brown accents.

item:cds_legacy_armor_heavy_legs_01_01_2.description: Revolutionary when first released, the ADP heavy armor system was heralded as the pinnacle of personal protection. item:omc_utility_heavy_legs_01_01_04.name: Corbel Legs Halcyon
item:omc_utility_heavy_legs_01_01_04.description:
Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Halcyon edition displays a sharp contrast of bold yellow and muted black.

item:cds_combat_heavy_arms_03_01_01.name: DCP Armor Arms Hunter Camo

item:cds_armor_heavy_arms_01_01_01.name: ADP-mk4 Arms Woodland
item:cds_armor_heavy_arms_01_01_01.description: When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers.

item:outlaw_legacy_heavy_armor_arms_01_0.name: Citadel Arms Earthwork
item:outlaw_legacy_heavy_armor_arms_01_0.description: Kastak Arms' aggressive design reached its peak with the Citadel. Layers of reinforced armor plating provide maximum security while its striking angular silhouette cuts an imposing figure. The Citadel-SE features a flourish of stylish script on the front chest plate and provides the same stellar protections thanks to advanced nanocomposite ballistic materials.

item:srvl_armor_heavy_arms_01_01_01.name: Overlord Arms Supernova
item:srvl_armor_heavy_arms_01_01_01.description: The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

item:rrs_specialist_heavy_arms_01_01_12.name: Morozov-SH Arms Aftershock
item:rrs_specialist_heavy_arms_01_01_12.description: Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining based on their recommendation; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart.

item:kap_combat_heavy_arms_01_01_15.name: Monolith Armor Arms Sandhawk
item:kap_combat_heavy_arms_01_01_15.description:

The Sandhawk variant features desert brown plating with slate gray accents.

item:omc_utility_heavy_arms_01_02_01.name: Corbel Arms Crush
item:omc_utility_heavy_arms_01_02_01.description:
Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight.

The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.

CDS refined and reshaped the ADP line over the years, but many still consider the original ADP to be the touchstone of military-grade heavy armor.

item:kap_combat_heavy_arms_01_03_01.name: Monolith Armor Arms Blackheart
item:kap_combat_heavy_arms_01_03_01.description:

item:rsi_utility_heavy_backpack_01_02_01.name: Zeus Exploration Backpack Keelback
item:rsi_utility_heavy_backpack_01_02_01.description: The Zeus Exploration Suit has been designed to honor some of the earliest space pioneers, the RSI crews who developed and tested the Zeus, the first commercial spacecraft. While the suit is styled to match those used centuries ago with attachments for a helmet and backpack, it contains all of the modern technology and conveniences expected by present-day explorers. The Zeus offers good resistance to harsh environments and excellent storage space for sample-collecting during EVAs. The Keelback edition features a combination of blue and yellow with a subtle reptile-skin pattern.

item:fps_consumable_template.name: MedPen (Hemozal)
item:fps_consumable_template.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife MedPen can rapidly dispense doses of the coagulant Hemozal during emergency situations to help relieve bleeding and improve a patient's overall vitals. Use only as recommended.

item:rrs_consumable_sedative_01.name: Drema Injector
item:rrs_consumable_sedative_01.description: Designed by RRS for field applications, this single-use device injects a fast-acting sedative into the target's body that will incapacitate the subject for a short duration preventing them from hurting themselves or others.

item:crlf_consumable_ea_medicateall_01.name: Treat Injuries
item:crlf_consumable_ea_medicateall_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife MedPen can rapidly dispense doses of the coagulant Hemozal during emergency situations to help relieve bleeding and improve a patient's overall vitals. Use only as recommended.

item:crlf_consumable_radiation_02.name: DeconPen Xtra
item:crlf_consumable_radiation_02.description: The DeconPen Xtra from CureLife delivers a rapid injection of both Canoiodide and Hemozal to not only treat radiation exposure but also improve a patient's overall vitals, getting patients stabilized faster than ever.

item:crlf_consumable_gopill_01.name: BoostPen (Modamphetamine)
item:crlf_consumable_gopill_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife BoostPen delivers a dose of the potent stimulant Modamphetamine to increase wakefulness and diminish awareness of pain in emergency situations.

item:crlf_consumable_radiation_01.name: DeconPen (Canoiodide)
item:crlf_consumable_radiation_01.description: The DeconPen from CureLife delivers a rapid injection of Canoiodide, a proprietary medicinal compound that treats radiation exposure.

item:crlf_consumable_gopill_02.name: BoostPen Xtra
item:crlf_consumable_gopill_02.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife BoostPen Xtra delivers a high dose of the potent stimulant Modamphetamine to greatly increase wakefulness and diminish awareness of pain in emergency situations.

item:crlf_consumable_radiationblocker_01.name: DeconPen (Canoiodide)
item:crlf_consumable_radiationblocker_01.description: The DeconPen from CureLife delivers a rapid injection of Canoiodide, a proprietary medicinal compound that treats radiation exposure.

item:crlf_consumable_tpn_01.name: VitalityPen
item:crlf_consumable_tpn_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife VitalityPen delivers a combination of total parenteral nutrition and the detoxicant Resurgera to help relieve symptoms associated with malnutrition and high blood drug levels (BDL).

item:crlf_consumable_painkiller_01.name: OpioPen (Roxaphen)
item:crlf_consumable_painkiller_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife OpioPen can rapidly dispense doses of the pain reliever Roxaphen during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with impaired mobility and partial paralysis. Use only as recommended.

item:crlf_consumable_healing_01.name: MedPen (Hemozal)
item:crlf_consumable_healing_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife MedPen can rapidly dispense doses of the coagulant Hemozal during emergency situations to help relieve bleeding and improve a patient's overall vitals. Use only as recommended.

item:crlf_consumable_adrenaline_01.name: AdrenaPen (Demexatrine)
item:crlf_consumable_adrenaline_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife AdrenaPen can rapidly dispense doses of the synthetic adrenaline Demexatrine during emergency situations to help relieve muscle fatigue and symptoms related to being concussed. Use only as recommended.

item:crlf_consumable_adrenaline_02.name: AdrenaPen Xtra
item:crlf_consumable_adrenaline_02.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife AdrenaPen Xtra contains a mixture of the synthetic adrenaline Demexatrine and an anticholinergic antiemetic, giving it extra power to relieve muscle fatigue and symptoms related to being concussed.

item:crlf_consumable_steroid_02.name: CorticoPen Xtra
item:crlf_consumable_steroid_02.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife CorticoPen Xtra dispenses the corticosteroid Sterogen with an extra boost of anticholinergic antiemetic to help relieve muscle weakness and blurred vision.

item:crlf_consumable_overdoserevival_01.name: DetoxPen (Resurgera)
item:crlf_consumable_overdoserevival_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife DetoxPen can rapidly dispense doses of the detoxicant Resurgera during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with high blood drug levels (BDL) and overdoses. Use only as recommended.

item:crlf_consumable_steroid_01.name: CorticoPen (Sterogen)
item:crlf_consumable_steroid_01.description: From the Empire's most trusted medical company, the CureLife CorticoPen can rapidly dispense doses of the corticosteroid Sterogen during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with muscle weakness and respiratory damage. Use only as recommended.

item:none_consumable_slam_02.name: SLAM
item:none_consumable_slam_02.description: Most commonly ingested as a gas. Vials of SLAM are cracked and inhaled. Initially developed as a performance enhancer for athletes, SLAM targets the user's nervous system acting as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Once the severe physical side effects were discovered, the drug went underground and found popularity among mercs and outlaws who relied on it to provide that slight edge in combat. Unfortunately, SLAM is also heavily addictive, so many of these mercs ended up getting burned out on the drug. Heavy-duty SLAM junkies are easily identifiable in public; they have 'the shakes' -- involuntary muscle twitches. Important to note that this is not a sign of withdrawal, simply a side effect.
